metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: by being good at chess, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But if you define super intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: as being able to operate in this living world of humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and be able to perform all kinds of different tasks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: consciousness, it seems to be somehow fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: To richly integrate yourself into the human experience,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: into society, it feels like you have to be a conscious being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But then we don't even know what consciousness is

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and we certainly don't know how to engineer it

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in our machines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I love the fact that there are still questions

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that are so embryonic because, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I suspect it's the same with you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Answers to me are simply ways to get to more questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: You know, it's questions where, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: questions turn me on, answers less so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I love the fact that we are still embryonic

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in our sense of arguing about even what the definition

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of consciousness is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But I also find it fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I think it's thoroughly delightful to absorb yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in the thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Think about the brain and we can move back

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: across the complexity of phylogeny from, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: humans to mammals to sort of birds to reptiles,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: amphibians, fish, and you can bacteria, whatever you want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And you can go through this and say, okay,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: where is the hard line of, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: what we would define as consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I'm sure it's got something to do with the complexity

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of the neural system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Of that, I'm fairly certain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But to me, it's always been fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So what is it then?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: You know, is it that I just keep adding neurons

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to a petri dish and I just keep adding them

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and adding them and adding them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: At some point when I hit a critical mass

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of interconnected neurons, that is the mass of the,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: you know, the interconnected human brain, then bingo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: All of a sudden it kicks into gear

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and we have consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Like a phase shift, phase transition of some kind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Correct, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But there is something about the complexity

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of the nervous system that I think is fundamental

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And the reason I bring that up is because

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: when we're trying to then think about creating it

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in an artificial way, does that inform us

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: as to the complexity that we should be looking at

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in terms of development?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I also think that it's a missed opportunity

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in the sort of digital space for us to try

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to recreate human consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: We've already got human consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: What if we were to think about creating some other form

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of, why do we have to think that the ultimate

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in the creation of an artificial intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: is the replication of a human state of consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Can we not think outside of our own consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and believe that there is something even more incredible

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: or more complimentary, more orthogonal?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So I'm sometimes perplexed that people are trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to mimic human consciousness rather than think

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: about creating something that's different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I think of human consciousness or consciousness in general

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: as this magic superpower that allows us

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to deeply experience the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And just as you're saying, I don't think that superpower

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: has to take the exact flavor as humans have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: That's my love for robots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I would love to add the ability to robots

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that can experience the world and other humans deeply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I'm humbled by the fact that that idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: does not necessarily need to look anything like

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: how humans experience the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But there's a dance of human to robot connection

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: the same way human to dog or human to cat connection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: That there's a magic there to that interaction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I'm not sure how to create that magic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but it's a worthy effort.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I also love just exactly as you said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: on the question of consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: or engineering consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: the fun thing about this problem is it seems obvious to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that a hundred years from now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: no matter what we do today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: people, if we're still here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: will laugh at how silly our notions were.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So like it's almost impossible for me to imagine

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that we will truly solve this problem fully in my lifetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And more than that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: everything we'll do will be silly a hundred years from now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but it's still a work that makes it fun to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: because it's like you have the full freedom

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to not even be right, just to try, just to try as freedom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And that's how I see it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Get me that T-shirt, please.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I love that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So, and you know, the human robot interaction is fascinating

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: because it's like watching dancing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I've been dancing tango recently,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and just, it's like, there is no goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: The goal is to create something magical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And whether consciousness or emotion or elegance of movement,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: all of those things aid in the creation of the magic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And it's a free, it's an art form to explore

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: how to make that, how to create that

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in a way that's compelling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Yeah, I love the line in Sense of a Woman with Al Pacino

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: where he's speaking about the tango.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And he said, really, it's just freedom

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that if you get tangled up, you just keep tangoing on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I still to this day, I think first to second time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I talked to Joe Rogan on his podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I said, we got into this heated argument

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: about whether Sense of a Woman is a better movie

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: than John Wick, because it's one of my favorite movies

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: for many reasons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: One is-

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Wick or Sense of a Woman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Sense of a Woman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Partially-

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I didn't know that by the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I was just kidding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: You just-

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Yeah, I didn't know if you would actually know

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of the movie.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Awesome, awesome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: No, yeah, I said, I love the tango scene.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I love Al Pacino's performance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It's a wonderful movie.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Then Joe was saying John Wick is better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So we to this day, argue about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I think it depends on what conscious state you're in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Yes, sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: That you would be ready and receptive to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But Sense of a Woman, I think it has one of the best

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: monologues at the end of the movie

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that has ever been written or at least performed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: When Al Pacino defends the younger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Yeah, I often think about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: There's been times in my life, I don't know about you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: where I wish I had an Al Pacino in my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Where integrity is really important in this life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And sometimes you find yourself in places

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: where there's pressure to sacrifice that integrity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And you want, what is it, Lieutenant Colonel

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: or whatever he was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: To come in. Slade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Yeah, to come in on your side and scream at everyone

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and say, what the hell are we doing here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Being, you know, unfortunately, British

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and sort of having that slightly awkward sort of

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Hugh Grant gene, it's very, very,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: the opposite end of the spectrum of the remarkable feet

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of Al Pacino at the end of that scene.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But, and yeah, integrity is, it's a challenging thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and I value it much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I think it can take 20 years to build a reputation

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and two minutes to lose it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And there is nothing more that I value than integrity

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and, you know, if I'm ever wrong about anything,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I truly don't want to be wrong

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: for any longer than I have to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: You know, that's what being in some ways a scientist is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: You're just driven by truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And the irony relative to something like mathematics

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: is that in science, you never find truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: What all you do in science is you discount the things

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that are likely to be untrue,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: leaving only the possibility of what could be true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But in math, you know, when you create, you know, a proof,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: it's a proof for, you know, from that point forward,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: there is truth in mathematics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And there's, I think there's a beauty in that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but I kind of like the messiness of science

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: because again, to me, it's less about the truth

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of the answer and it is more about the pursuit of questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But their integrity becomes more and more important

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and it becomes more difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: There's a lot of pressures,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: just like in the rest of the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but there's a lot of pressures on a scientist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: One is like funding sources.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I've noticed this that, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: money affects everyone's mind, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I've been always somebody that I believe money can't,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: you can't buy my opinion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I don't care how much money, billions or trillions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But that pressure is there

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and you have to be very cognizant of it

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and make sure that your opinion is not defined

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: by the funding sources.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And then the other is just your own success of, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: for a couple of decades, publishing an idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and then realizing at some point

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that that idea was wrong all along.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And that's a tough thing for people to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but that's also integrity is to walk away,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: is to say that you were wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: That doesn't have to be in some big, dramatic way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It could be in a bunch of tiny ways along the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Like reconfigure your intuition about a particular problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: That's, and all of that is integrity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: When everybody in the room believes a certain thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: everybody in the community believes a certain thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to be able to still be open-minded in the face of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Yeah, and I think it comes down in some ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to the issue of ego, that you bond your correctness

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: or your rightness, your scientific theory

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: with your sense of ego.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: You know, I've never found it that difficult to let go

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of theories in the face of counter evidence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in part because I have such low self-esteem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Well, I kind of like that.

body.input: So such a subtle, but such a fundamental difference, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Oh, goodness me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Sleep with the problem.

body.input: Yes, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: That's why I love the French.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So, and we can sort of double click on any one of these

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and go into detail, but the fourth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I became really enchanted by about eight years ago

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in our research, which was this idea of forgetting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I started to think that forgetting may be the price

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that we pay for remembering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And in that sense, there is an enormous benefit

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to letting go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And you may be thinking, that sounds ridiculous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I don't want to forget.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: In fact, my biggest problem is I keep forgetting things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but the brain has a, well, we believe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: has a finite storage capacity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: We can't prove it yet, but my suspicion is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that's probably true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It doesn't have an infinite storage capacity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It has constraints.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: If that's the case, we can't simply go through life

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: being constantly informational aggregators,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: unless we are programmed to say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: we've got a hard drive space of about 85 to 90 years

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and we're good and we can do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Maybe that's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I don't think that's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I think forgetting is an incredibly good and useful thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So for example, it's not beneficial

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: from an evolutionary perspective for me to remember

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: where I parked my car three years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So it's important that I can remember today's parking spot,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but I don't want to have the junk kind of DNA

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: from a memory perspective of where I parked my car

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: two years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Now, I actually have in some ways a problem with forgetting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I'm, and again, I'm not trying to sort of be laudatory,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but I tend not to forget too many things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I don't think that that's a good thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And there's a wonderful neurologist, Luria,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: who wrote a book called The Mind of the Mnemonicist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And it was a brilliant book,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: both because it was written exquisitely,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but he was studying these sort of memory savants

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: who basically could remember everything that he gave them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And he tried to find a chink in their armor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And the first half of the book is essentially about him

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: seeing how far he can push them before they fail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And he never found that place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: He could never find a place where they stopped remembering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And then in his brilliance,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: he turned the question on its head.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: He said, not what is the benefit of constantly remembering,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but instead what is the detriment to never forgetting?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And when you start to realize his descriptions

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of those individuals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: it's probably a life that you would not want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But it's fascinating both from a human perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but also AI perspective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: There's a big challenge in the machine learning community

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of how to build systems that are able to remember

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: for prolonged periods of time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: lifelong continuous learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So where you build up information over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So memory is one of the biggest open problems

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in AI and machine learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But at the same time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: the right way to formulate memory is actually forgetting

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: because you have to be exceptionally selective

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: at which kind of stuff you remember.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And that's where the step of assimilation integration

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that you're referring to is really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I mean, we forget most of the things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And the question is exactly the cost of forgetting

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: at the very edge of stuff that could be important

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: or could not be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: How do we remember or not those things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Like for example, I've doing a podcast,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I've become cognizant of one feature of my forgetting

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that's been problematic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: which is I forget names and titles of books and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So when I read, I remember ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I remember quotes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I remember statements and like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that's the space in which I'm thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But when you communicate to others,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: you have to say this person in this book said that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So it's the same thing with like Andrew Huberman

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: as masterful at this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It's this important academia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: remembering the authors of a paper

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and the title of the paper as part of remembering the idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I've been feeling the cost of not being able

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to naturally remember those things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And so that's something I need to sort of work on.

body.input: Yeah.

body.input: Yeah.

body.input: But I think there's certain quirks of social interaction

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So I think the, again, the point was simply

body.input: with depression as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: You know, Edison is interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: People have argued that he would short sleep

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and he didn't put much value in sleep,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: whether or not that's true, we don't know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but he was a habitual napper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: You're right, during the day,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I've got some great pictures of him

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: on his inventor's bench taking a nap.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And in fact, I believe he set up nap cots around his house

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: so he could nap.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But what we also know is study, again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: coming out of Harvard just a couple of months ago,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: demonstrated very clearly that polyphasic sleep

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: is associated with worse physical outcomes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: worse cognitive outcomes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and especially worse mood outcomes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So from that sense, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: sleeping like a baby is not perfect for adults.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So there's a fascinating dance here

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of the mean and the extreme,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: like the average and the high performers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So I...

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: This gets to like the meaning of life kind of discussion,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but let's go that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And also happiness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So when studying sleep and when studying anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: like diet and exercise,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I think you have to really get a lot more data

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: about individuals to make conclusive statements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: When people talk about like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: is red meat good for you or bad for you, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It's just so often correlated with other life decisions

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: when you choose to eat meat or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: My sense is that whatever life decisions you make,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: if they reduce stress and lead to happiness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that's also going to be a big boost

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that needs to be integrated into the plots

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in the science, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So I'll give you an example of somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: who was unarguably seen as unhealthy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: My friend, Mr. David Goggins.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So he's clearly, obviously,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: almost on purpose destroying his body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And to say that he's doing the wrong thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: or the unhealthy thing feels wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But I'm not sure exactly in which way he feels wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: One of the things I'm bothered by,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and again, I apologize for the therapy sessions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: a framework of this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but I'm bothered by the fact that

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: a lot of people tell me or David

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that they're doing things wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: A lot of people in my life, when they see me not sleep,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: they'll tell me to sleep more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Now they're correct,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but one fundamental aspect that I'd like to complain about

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: is not enough people, almost nobody,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: especially people that care for me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: will come to me and say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: you have a dream, work harder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It's like the healthy thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: should be a component of a life well lived,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but not everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I don't know what to do with that

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: because you certainly don't want to espouse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And just like you said, when you were working in your book,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: there is a belief,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: sleep was a secondary citizen in the full spectrum

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of what's a healthy life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But at the same time, I'm bothered by in Silicon Valley

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and all these kinds of work environments

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that I get to work with with engineers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: is there's to me too much focus on work-life balance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: What that usually starts meaning is like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: yeah, yeah, of course, it's good to have a social life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: it's good to have a family,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: it's good to eat well and sleep well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but we should also discover our passion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: We should also give ourselves a chance

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to work our ass off towards a dream

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and make mistakes and take big risks

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that in the short term seem to sacrifice health.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I think, to come back to how you started

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: about David Goggins, who I've never met,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but who I admire incredibly

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and have an immense reverence for the man,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: you said two things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: is it wrong to do those things to yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and is it unhealthy to do those things to yourself?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I disagree with the former and I agree with the latter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So from a health biological medicine perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: sleeping in the way that you've described

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: or that other people may be sleeping

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in terms of insufficient amounts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: now to your point too about individual differences,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: usually when I see a bar graph and a mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I usually say, show me your variance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I want to see your variance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: In other words, show me the distribution of that effect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: How many people were below the mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: How many, is it all tightly clustered around this one thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So it's a very robust effect

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: or was this huge fan of effect where for some people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: there was no effect at all in other people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: it was a whopping effect and everything in between.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So I don't discount into individual variability

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but and I will come back to those two points about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: is it wrong and is it unhealthy in just a second?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: When it comes to sleep,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: we have found huge amounts of individual differences

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in your response to a lack of sleep

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but one of the fascinating things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: so let's say that I take you on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: we're going to measure your attention, your emotion,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: your mood, your blood pressure,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: your blood sugar glucose regulation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: your autonomic nervous system

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and your different gene expression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Let's say I'm just going to measure a whole kaleidoscope

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of different outcomes, brain and body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I find that on our measure of cognition

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: on your attentional ability to focus,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: you are very resilient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: You just don't show any impairment at all

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: even after being awake for 36 hours straight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Does that mean that you are resilient

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in all of those other domains as well?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: The answer is no, you're not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So you can be resilient in one

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but very vulnerable in another

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and we've not found anyone who isn't at least vulnerable

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in one of those domains,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: meaning that it's somewhat safe to say

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that not getting sufficient sleep

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: will lead to some kind of impairment

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in anyone given individual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It may not be the same impairment

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but it's likely to be an impairment

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but to come back to the question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I think it's wrong to tell anyone

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that it's wrong to do what they're doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: even if they are compromising their sleep,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: even if they're compromising their mental health.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: As long as they're not hurting anyone else,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: then I think the answer is that's that person's choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Yeah, but I'd like to push back further.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So you see the way you kind of said it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: yes, you're absolutely right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But I would like to say a stronger statement

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: which is you should let go of that judgment

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of somebody is wrong and allow yourself to be inspired

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: by the great heights they have reached.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So take yourself out of the seat

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of being a judger of what is healthy or not

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and appreciate the greatness of a particular human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: You watch the Olympics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: the kind of things that some athletes do

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to reach the very heights.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: The Olympics are taking years off their life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: They suffer depression after the Olympics often.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: The physiology is disastrous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Everything, their personal life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: there's their psychology, their physiology, everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It's a giant mess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So the question is about life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Healthy now means longevity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: quality of life over a prolonged period of time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: optimum performance over a prolonged period of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But to me, beauty is reaching great heights.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And there's a dance there that sometimes reaching

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: great heights requires sacrifice of health

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and not like a calculation where you sat down

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: on a sheet of paper and say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I'm going to take seven years off my life

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: for an Olympic gold medal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: No, it requires more chaotic journey

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that doesn't do that kind of calculus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I just want to kind of speak to the,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in the culture that struggles of what is healthy and not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: we want to be able to speak to what is healthy

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and at the same time be inspired by the great heights

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that humans reach no matter how healthy

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: or unhealthy they live.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Yeah, I agree with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I think if that's a flag you're hoisting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I will definitely salute it because it really depends,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: what are you trying to optimize for in your life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And if you are, I think the only danger potentially

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: with that mindset is that if you look at many of the studies

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: of old age and end of life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: most people say I never look back on my life

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and wish I worked harder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I wish instead I'd spent more time

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: with family, friends and engaged in that aspect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Now I'm not saying though, coming back to it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: your point that that is the standard rubric for everyone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I don't believe it is too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And there are many things that you and I

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: are both benefiting from today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: even in the field of medicine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: where people have sacrificed their own longevity

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: for the quest of solving a particular medical problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And they died quicker because of their commitment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: because they wished to try and solve that problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: in their pursuit of greatness scientifically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I now benefit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Am I grateful that they did that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: Incredibly grateful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: A simpler demonstration is this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: if tonight at 4 a.m. in the morning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I have a ruptured appendix, I have an appendicitis,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I am incredibly grateful that there is an emergency team

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that will take me to the hospital at 4 a.m. in the morning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: They are awake, they're not sleeping,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: and they save my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And that's part of what their life's mission and quest is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And they saved another's life by, in some ways,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: shaving a little of their own off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So I have no umbrage with that mentality at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But this included, I'm neither a strong morning type

body.input: nor a strong evening type.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So ideally I'd probably like to go to bed around 11,

body.input: 10, 30, 11, probably somewhere between 10, 30, 11

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I love it.

body.input: And so I-

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: That's kind of awesome.

body.input: I've never heard about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: That's amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: I'm gonna start doing that now,

body.input: setting alarms like a little bit off the-

body.input: Yeah, I'm never quite sure why we all-

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It's a celebration of uniqueness.

body.input: Yeah, and I am quite the odd snowflake in that sense too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And I quickly abandoned that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: But if I look back, if there was a shameful act

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: that I have around my sleep, I think it would be that

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: for some years until I really started

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: to get more detailed into sleep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: And now I have no shame in telling people that I will

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: probably usually wake up around 6.45 naturally,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: sometimes seven when people are looking at me thinking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: If I could, I would work 16 hours.

body.input: It's my passion just like yours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: So I don't feel shame around that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: but I have changed my mentality around that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: It's complicated because I'm probably happiest going to bed

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: if I'm being honest, like at 5 a.m.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: That's fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Matt Walker: Sleep | Lex Fridman Podcast #210

body.input: You're just an extreme evening type.

body.input: But the problem is,

body.input: it's not that I'm ashamed for it.

body.input: I actually kind of enjoy it because I get to sleep
