body.input: The following is a conversation with Niels Jorgensen, a New York firefighter for over 21 years, who was there at Ground Zero on September 11th, 2001.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He was forced to retire because of the leukemia he contracted from cleaning up Ground Zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: This podcast tells his story and the story of other great men and women who were there that day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Some of the stories we talk about are part of a new limited podcast series that Niels hosts called 20 for 20, with 20 episodes for the 20 years since 9-11.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: To support this podcast, please check out our sponsors in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: As a side note, please allow me to say a few words about the terrorist attacks on September 11th, 2001.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I was in downtown Chicago on that day, lost in the mundane busyness of an early Tuesday morning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: At that time, I was already fascinated by human nature, the best and the worst of it, exploring it through the study of history and literature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: In the years before, as a young boy growing up in Russia, I saw chaos, uncertainty, and desperation in the Soviet Union of the 1990s, wrapping up a century of war and suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But after coming to America for me, there was a sense of hope, like all of it was behind us, a bad dream to be forgotten as we enter into the new century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: On 9-11, when I saw the news of the second plane hitting the towers, my sense of hope had changed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I understood that the 21st century, like the century before, would too have its tragedies, its evildoers, its wars, and its suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And unlike the history books, these stories will involve all of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They will involve me, in however small and insignificant a role, but one that nevertheless carries the responsibility to help.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I became an American that day, a citizen of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I felt the common humanity in all of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I felt the unity and the love in the days that followed, and I think most of the world shared in this feeling, that we are all in this together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Evil cannot defeat the human spirit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: There were many heroes, sung and unsung on that day, and in the years after.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Often, politicians fail to rightfully honor the service and sacrifice of these heroes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: There is much I could say about that, but I don't want to waste my words on the failures of weak leaders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Instead, I want to say thank you to the men and women who rushed to Ground Zero to help, who put on a uniform to serve, who make me proud to be an American and a human being, and give me hope about the future of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Here, on a small spinning rock, that despite the long odds, keeps kindling the fire of human consciousness and love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman Podcast, and here is my conversation with Niels Jorgensen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Take me through the day of September 11th, 2001, as you experienced it, as you lived it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Take me through the day of September 11th, 2001, as you experienced it, as you lived it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: September 11th, 2001 was a bright, beautiful, sunny Tuesday morning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was a late summer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: There's a lot of folks who go to the beaches in New Jersey call it the short summer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Everybody's left there for Labor Day, but it's still beautiful enough to enjoy the weather.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I left my house about 6.30 in the morning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: My four and a half year old daughter said to me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Daddy, which truck are you driving today?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: The fire truck, the oil truck, or the boar's head truck?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Because I had three jobs at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Most New York City firefighters and police officers, EMS, we don't make the most amount of money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So in order to live in that city, you have to hustle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: My wife stayed at home raising the children.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: My daughter said, oh, you should be safe because you're on the oil truck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I told her I was going on an oil truck that day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: She said, you should be safe today, Daddy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So I left and worked for this great company on the North Shore of Staten Island, Quinlan Fuel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Very nice people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Treated me very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was my first day back actually for the winter season.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Usually get laid off a couple months in the summer because things are too hot to need oil.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So I took the truck, started my route that day and clean hit the tower.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So initially I'm like, oh, it's probably some silly Learjet pilot and he veered off track to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: get a better picture for a client and he hit the building.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Probably hit a bad turbulence, gust of wind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It's very windy down in that area of Manhattan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So that was my first thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Can we pause there for a second?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So six days, six days, six days.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Can we pause there for a second? So 6.30 a.m.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You wake up, you leave and then the plane hits at 8.45 a.m.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220
Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Just interesting how you phrase it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So how did you hear that a plane hit something?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I'm a big news radio guy, news guy, a bit of a buff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I've been that way since I was a kid and I had the news radio on

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the local New York radio station and as I was driving the truck, I heard

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: an emergency report this just in, aircraft has just struck the World Trade Center.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And where Quinlan's is located, it's on the North Rim of Staten Island,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: which is right on New York Harbor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And you could see Statue of Liberty, a mile or two away in your distance and then past that is

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the towers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So I just literally stopped the truck and looked out and I saw the smoke.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So there was smoke.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Oh, it was dark black smoke.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was just, yeah, I mean, it was burning fully at that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And did you have fear of what the hell happened or is it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I was initially scared for anybody involved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I realized I said there's going to be lots of fatalities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: obviously, depending on the size of the aircraft.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And the business day there had started probably at 8, 8.30.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So those buildings should have been packed at that moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So that was a thought across my mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But from our being responder perspective, if you're off duty, normally you do not go to a scene.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They don't want you to because of accountability and safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: The on duty platoon will handle it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And if it's something very horrific, then they will have something called a recall,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: which is any police firefighter or EMS personnel is obligated to go to their command immediately,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: check in with, you know, their command, get their gear and stand by and await orders for deployment

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: or to remain in that command for routine duties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: How often throughout history have there been recalls?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I believe the one prior to that was like in the 1968 riots, possibly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And then maybe in the 70s, there was another blackout and riots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I remember my dad talking about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he actually always said, just remember if something bad is going down,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: don't just rush in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You will wait the recall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Or at the very least, if there isn't a recall, you get to your firehouse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And because if you show up somewhere, there's a good chance that no one knows you're there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And now in your well-intended movements, you get lost or trapped or no one's looking for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So that's the whole thing with, you know, checking in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And now you're with a squad or, you know, group of guys and everyone knows, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: hey, there's Nels, there's Lex, okay, they're on this team.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So I said, all right, they're not going to need us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It's probably going to be a fifth alarm and, you know, there'll be 250 firefighters there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They'll handle it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It's going to be a bad day for those guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But, you know, our guys take on some heavy stuff and they'll be fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: A few minutes later, the second plane hit and I knew immediately.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I'm like, okay, we're under attack.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So I just flew the truck back in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I told my boss, you know, I'm going to be there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I told my boss, I have to go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He understood he knew something was way wrong and I just was flying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: At the time, I actually had a yellow Volkswagen Beetle, kind of a goofy car to be driving,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but I loved it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So for people who are just listening, you're kind of a big guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Well, yeah, I could, I definitely need to lose about 50 pounds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: No, I don't mean in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Your frame, big hands.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: As my beloved friend, Bobby Adams would say to me, I was driving around in a clown wagon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He also says I have a waving hairdo, waving bye bye.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So thanks, Bobby.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Good luck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yeah, he's a great friend.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yeah, so I took the Volkswagen and I flew in and I was heading over to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the Verrazano Bridge and hit the Brooklyn Queens Expressway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And my phone rang and my wife normally doesn't curse or raise a voice and she was yelling at me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And she said, don't go in there, go to your firehouse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: First she asked where, she knew I was on the way, but she just wanted to know where.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I said, I'm on the curve, which is 65th Street on the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Brooklyn Queens Expressway called Dead Man's Curve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We actually used to do a lot of car wrecks up there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I was hitting that curve pretty fast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And then right around the curve is the exit to the firehouse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I had to decide, well, am I driving right in to the battery tunnel to the city

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: or am I going to the firehouse?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And then I said, but I have no gear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I'm going to be ineffective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: How do I show up with no gear, no protection?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: She said, do what your dad would follow the recall, go to the firehouse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I hung up the phone and said, I love you, gotta go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I did, I went to the firehouse and I'm glad I listened to her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I had my father ringing in my ears.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: My dad, beautiful guy, he's 82, 34 years in New York City Fire Department.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He came down on end stage, non-hazardous lymphoma.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He's 38, going on 39, 1978.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And this guy, he's my hero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He was going to die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They sent him home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They said, there's really not much we can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Go get your affairs in order.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he says, but doc, I have three young kids.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And she called him a couple of hours later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: She said, I got in touch with Sloan Kettering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And they have a new drug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We want you to be a test pilot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He said, hey doc, he's got a heavy Brooklyn accent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I'm a fireman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I'm a fireman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I'm not a pilot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So she said, no, no, we want you to try this drug out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And if it works, we may have some success.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But if not, he says, yeah, I'm going to die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So let's do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So every two weeks for four years, he'd go for treatment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But he was assigned to a desk job after that, after the cancer

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: tumor removal and the heavy treatments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he'd get up every morning at 4 o'clock in the morning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he'd walk down to the train station in Staten Island,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: take the train.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And then he'd take the ferry across the harbor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he'd get off looking at the towers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And then he'd take a subway into Brooklyn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And on every other Thursday, he'd leave at noon, do the same

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: exact reverse route.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he'd get to the cancer center.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And my mom would meet him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he'd get his infusion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And within two hours, he'd be violently ill for a few days,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: really badly ill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I just remember, I was 10 years old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he just had to have the room darkened out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he'd be so sick.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I'd just go in and wipe the vomit on his face.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Just try to give him a little water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But he couldn't take it down because he'd throw it up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And maybe on Saturday, he'd start coming around a little

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: bit, drink down a little bit of tea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And on Sunday morning, he'd put his robe on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He'd go down, mom would make him black coffee and toast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He'd sit up, watch the news, watch a game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And then Monday morning, he'd go back to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he did that for four years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he's 82.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he's still here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You said that your dad's a man of a few words, but when he

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: talks, they're profound.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So what words were ringing in your ear when you were driving?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I just always remember him saying, kid, they give the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: recall, you go to the firehouse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You don't go where you think you should.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You go to the firehouse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You follow your orders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So do the smart thing, do your job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yes, sir.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And every time we'd hang up the phone, it's fireman talk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He'd say, I love you, keep low.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: My dad couldn't tell me he loved me until I told him when

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I first got on a fight, I was 22.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: My dad grew up in a tough household.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: My granddad was a good man, but a tormented man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He was sent away from home at 12 years old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He was from Denmark, and I'm named after him, Grandpa Nils.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I think his demons took up a large part of his life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: His anger, whatever it was, his fear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We got the sense that maybe when he was a child, he was an

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: apprentice baker, living with strangers, working for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And we think maybe he was abused, and that's why he took

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it out on my dad and my grandma and my aunts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But they made it up to each other at the end of my granddad's

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: My granddad turned out to be the best grandfather ever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I think he tried to heal and heal everyone by his change of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So he's proof that you can change, you can improve if you

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: work on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But I know I'm going off track here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But you were man enough, you say, in your 20s to tell your

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: dad that you love him?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: My dad, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I got on a job, and he said, I had a go, kid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: That was the tour we called Tour of Duty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I said, oh, dad, it was great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I love it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he goes, just remember, you keep low.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You always keep low.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And keep low means you stay down below the flames.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: If a room flashes over and it's burning, if you stay up high,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you're going to get burned badly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But if you get down on your belly and you crawl, you'll get

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So he'd always say that when you hang up the phone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: was a 10th alarm assignment, which means 50, 60 fire trucks, five to six guys per

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: hour.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You're looking at at least, there was even more, a 10th alarm plus multiple

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: alarms on top of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: There was a dispatch basically equivalent of five to 600 firefighters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And we figured, oh, they're all in there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They're all gone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: All the police officers, Port Authority police, NYPD police, court officers just

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: up the street from the courts, transit cops from the train tunnels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We knew everybody was going and now they're gone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So what you saw, what were we looking at?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: What did it look like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So you saw rubble and then you knew that 105 and 201, many of those guys are

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: in there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They're dead.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And we thought 114 was in there too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We didn't realize at that point, we didn't even realize that they had gotten

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: under that truck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We thought they were all gone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But yeah, it looked like a movie scene with just end of the earth destruction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: These just massive piles of intertwined steel, what was left of the steel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And there was no cement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was all just dust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And it was just a burning pile of dust and concrete and plastic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And it was just, everything was just pulverized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And it was truly hard to mentally compute that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And then there was just fighter jets, a couple of fighter jets just circling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And you just heard the flying by over your head.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I mean, you'd literally see the guy banking a turn around a Brooklyn bridge and just

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: coming back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I'm like, holy shoot, we're on their attack.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And we couldn't really get concrete intel as to what exactly, we knew planes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But then we kept hearing there was multiple devices.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: There was devices in a battery tunnel and there was devices on a George Washington

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: bridge and in the subways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And it was just chaos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We kept it together, obviously, because that's kind of, we try.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: That's what we do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But the just constant barrage of different reports, it was like, holy shoot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And then as we were being deployed, it was a little frustrating, but they were trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to take command and send us in groups now because they realized we have to start

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: searching this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You could hear the alarms on the Scott Air Mask, the packs we wear to go into the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: building.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It has a motion alarm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And if you stop moving for 30 seconds, it just sounds like this whining, this

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: screaming bell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Like it just keeps going and going.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And you could hear multiple units of those going off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And you're like, wait a minute, there's guys with those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Where are they?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And it's emanating from underneath the pile.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And it was just surreal and truly like a war zone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I was a soldier in the reserves and I never saw combat and I would never claim

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that I did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But we trained.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We trained for a lot of situations and we trained in real life atmospheres and

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: whatnot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And this was just beyond that by leaps and bounds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was bizarre.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Did you see the towers collapse?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: As we were coming over the bridge, the first one, as we were deploying from the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: firehouse, we had a television on and I saw it go down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And it just, it was just like, and we were so involved in getting gear together

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and getting, okay, team set up and okay, you're going to be with these two guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I just yelled, I said, guys, and they're looking at me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I dropped to my knees and I started praying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They're like, what the hell is wrong?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I said, I couldn't even say it's like 114, they're in there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And they're like, what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I said, the tower's gone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And all you saw on the TV was just this pile of dust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I guess because they didn't see it going down, I probably thought I truly lost it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And then the realization came as like, oh, wow, the tower's down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So now it was like, wow, this is really on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So we just took off and got that bus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And so if you thought many of the guys in 114 were dead,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: if you thought that, did you think you're going to die?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I mean, if you're rushing into the towards the rubble,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: as crazy as it sounds, I never thought that the other tower would go down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I said, okay, maybe some freak chance that one went down,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but now the other one's not going to go like they're built so strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You know, I was in those towers so many times and I made dinner up in the top four

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: restaurant windows on the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I'm saying, nah, there's no way like how the hell did this one happen?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But I was having a hard time mentally processing that the building was gone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And believe me, if you don't have fear in this industry and police, fire, military,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: then you're kidding yourself or you're a danger to everyone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I don't care who it is, as tough as they are, this and that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Everybody has a certain level of fear with doing this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I don't care how long you do it, there's always that chance of something going bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And everyone who does it has that certain amount of fear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But at that point, it was such a feeling of disbelief

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that fear wasn't even kicking in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was just like, what the hell just happened?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I honestly think it was almost like a shock and it just stayed that whole day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So the building is, before it collapses, is burning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It's just burning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I mean, upper floors, it's up in the 78th, up to the 80s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And then there's the way that the cut was from the plane.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It wasn't just straight across.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was from the 78th, then on up to maybe the 86th.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And then the jet fuel had come down and was burning down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And there was people on the ground who were doused with jet fuel that was already burning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And they were lit on fire on the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was just insane how vast the destruction path was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: As a firefighter, what are you supposed to do with that scale of fire?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I think the first bosses in, the first chiefs, were just going to do their best to get,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: as we get hose lines, what our whole theory is, our tactics is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: is to get water at the fire, at the base of the fire, and get the truck company,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: which is the ladder company.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They're the guys who break the doors down, put ladders up, this and that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to get them to where the life is most expected and get them out of there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So I think the chiefs' tactics at that point was, let me get multiple engine companies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Let me get four, five, six hose lines fighting this fire, this massive fire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And let me get 15, 20 truck companies up there, just yoking people out of there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yeah, but you got to go up the stairs. Everything's not working.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yeah, guys had to walk up 80, 80, 90, 100 flights of stairs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And there's audio of officers and firefighters speaking to each other on the radio channels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And unfortunately, at that point in time, we had very, very bad communication system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We'd been fighting for years to get radios that work properly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We couldn't because it was a lot of money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We fought for years to get the full bunker firefighting suits,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: which is the pants and the coat. We used to have just coats and these roll-up rubber boots,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and guys were burning to death. And we had to fight. And unfortunately,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: we lost three guys in one vicious, vicious fire in 1994. And then they finally said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: enough's enough. Give these guys the gear. So it's a strange phenomenon in the first responder world

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and in the military world. It's really one of the most important things that takes place in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: society. The most pertinent organizations, and we can't get the funding we need. It's crazy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They'll throw money at every nonsensical thing. But when it comes to gear, equipment, protective

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: equipment, trucks, this couldn't get it. Just all the ways you could take care of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I saw since 9-11, the wars in the Middle East have cost America over $6 trillion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And the amount of that money that was spent on the soldiers, in this case, the first responders,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: is minimal. Compared to it, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Almost nothing. They closed down, I believe it's either seven or eight. In May of 2002, they closed

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: down nine firehouses in New York City for budget reasons. We hadn't even finished cleaning up the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: World Trade Center site and they slashed the budget and still to this day have not reopened

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: those firehouses. There's a million more people now living in New York City than there were in 2001.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And the fire protection is way less than it was. And it's a sin. It's really a sin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Can I ask you a difficult question? So there's this famous photograph of a falling star.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: A photograph of a falling man. So many people had to decide when they're above the fire or in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: fire, whether to jump out of the building or to burn to death. What do you make of that decision?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: What do you make of that situation? Those people who jumped, those were acts of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: sheer desperation. I've been in fires and just minor, burned, but minor in situation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but I've been trapped or caught somewhat. Ended up in a burn center for nothing serious at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But for those brief seconds, half a minute was thank God, if I didn't have my fire gear on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I would have been burned to a very, very horrible level. Those people were burning

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: alive and they had the choice of either to stay there and burn alive or to launch themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And some of them, I don't fault them, but they had a few folks, they won't show it anymore because

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: they say, I don't know why I had offend some people, but they had a couple of folks that took

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: umbrellas and they took garbage bags because they thought that it would slow down their acceleration

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: rate to the ground and maybe just maybe they wouldn't be killed. And that's to me, a true

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: sense of desperation for humanity to say, I'm going to die either way, but let me take my chance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I don't know the exact number of those folks who did that, but our first member of the fire

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: department killed firefighter Daniel Cerf from 216 was struck by a jumper. And one of my dear

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: friends was ordered to help take him and they knew he was passed away because he was hit by a flying

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: missile. I mean, 120 miles an hour body lands on you, those two bodies are now crushed. And they

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: were ordered to take that firefighter and bring him across the street to engine 10, ladder 10.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was literally a firehouse, less than a hundred yards from the facade of the trade center, from

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the trade center complex. They literally right there. And there was plane parts that went into

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that firehouse, landed into the front doors, onto the roof, but the building itself was not destroyed

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: so it was used as a mini command center for quite a while. So my friend was ordered to take Daniel's

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: body in respect and bring it over to this firehouse and give it some semblance of dignity and lay it

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: out on one of the bunk room, the bunks we have in the bunk house and just cover it with a sheet and

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: put a sign, please firefighter killed, do not disturb. And then we'll get to him later because

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: obviously this operation is going to go on for days. And my friend who's such a great, great,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: wonderful guy is so still to this day filled with guilt because if they weren't taking his body out

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: with the respect and dignity that they did, it took a while because it's a tough situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: His ladder company was coming over the bridge. There's a famous picture of ladder 118. You see

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: this tractor trailer fire truck. It's the one with the guy in the back also drives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And it's a zoomed out shot and you see the Brooklyn bridge and you see only the fire truck in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: middle and you see the two burning towers in the distance. Well, his engine company was just ahead

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: of them on the bridge. And the only reason that engine company lived is their initial duty

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: assignment was to take that firefighter and bring his body over. It's like the military. We don't

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: leave anyone behind. These are our guys. As some guys say, it's all about the guy right next to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you and nothing else really matters. When that guy right next to you goes down, it stops. You get

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that guy to safety or if he's dead, you get him out. So in that timeframe, that saved his life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but that's a heavy burden to carry now for the rest of your life because you say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: if I wasn't helping my dead friend, I'm dead. What did it look like at ground zero? What did it feel

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: like? What did it smell like? You said there was a sense that it was almost like a war zone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but can you paint the picture of how much dust is in the air? How hot is it? How many people are

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: there? And again, how did it feel like? It was just, it was a scene of control chaos,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: control because there was a semblance of command and we were just trying to do our jobs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But it was such a frantic pace because we're now digging frantically knowing that there's life

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: underneath this pile. And this is throughout the afternoon of that evening. Yeah. I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220
