body.input: this was nonstop, just nonstop really for days, but for my particular crew, we literally kept going.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We initially were dispatched over towards number seven, had just gone down and we were searching

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the post office that was there. There was reports of people trapped and we painstakingly searched

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: every single inch of that building to make sure no one was left in there. And then we were deployed

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to the pile and the pile is sort of ambiguous because it was just such a vast, vast pile.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I mean, it went for city blocks and we were assisting in the retrieval of two port authority

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: police officers were lucky enough to survive, but they were trapped. They were deep down into a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: crevasse and they had to be physically dug out and extricated. So there was a couple hundred,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: a few hundred guys involved in that process of bringing in equipment, jaws of life, airbags to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: lift steel, to cut pieces of steel. It was just a huge operation. And we were back toward the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: logistics end of it, shuttling in gear and bringing in stretchers, bringing in oxygen,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: whatever was needed. And you were trying to climb over this jagged pile of debris. It wasn't like

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you just walked a hundred feet on a street with something. You were trying to climb over this

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I-beam and then down into this hole and then back up that hole. I mean, just to run one piece of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: equipment took a half an hour to get a hundred feet, 200 feet. Mind you, some of these pieces

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: of equipment are a hundred pounds, generator for a hearse tools, this massive motor on a frame.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Unstable ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Unstable ground, just horrible conditions. Fires were still burning aside you, beneath you. And at

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: one point I veered off to the side and I was with this other fireman from my father's old ladder

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: company, 172. And it was strange because we were down quite a bit down, like 70 feet down into this

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: ravine of debris. And he says, brother, what are you here? And at the time it was like dust,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it was like sand just falling down a pile and it was hissing from gas pipes and water pipes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I said, I hear the gas lines, I hear the sand, I hear the concrete. He goes, no, no,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: what else do you hear? And just the side of us was a lady's pocketbook and a high heel shoe

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and someone's sneaker with nobody with it. And I said, I don't know, I don't hear anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He says, me neither. He goes, no one's coming out of here. And I said, no, no, no, there's got to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: be someone coming out of here. I mean, there's thousands of people in here and they're coming

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: out. He says, brother, we would hear them calling for help, they're gone. And I still at that point

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: thought there was a chance. And after about the fourth day, they just said, this is a recovery

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: now. There's no more life, there's no more chance. And on that first night, we went full tilt till

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: my crew, my specific crew of 12, 15 guys and four in the morning, we just couldn't breathe anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We couldn't see, we were caked. It was like if you took flour and just kept dousing yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And the lieutenant just said, look guys, we're going to go back, we're going to get some medical

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: aid and then we'll come back in a few hours. And we took a city bus back through the battery tunnel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And unbeknownst to us, that morning, this off duty firefighter, Steven Siller from Squad Company One,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: he raced down there with his pickup and he couldn't go any further because the traffic was

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: stopped up because they had a report of a bomb. So everything was held up. And he grabbed his fire gear

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and he put it on, stuff weighs about 60 pounds. And he ran through the tunnel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Two and a half miles, got to the end of the tunnel, fire truck was coming in from the other way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He hopped on the back, got him up to West Street, jumped off, tried to look for his company where

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: they were. And he was never seen again. He just ran through the tunnel. Ran through the tunnel

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and he got there to help his team. It's all about the teams, all about the guy right next to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he's the tunnel to towers foundation, Steven. His brother, Frank, decided in his name,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: in perpetuity, he's got a fund that now builds a home for every Gold Star family,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: for every seriously battle wounded warrior, for every seriously wounded first responder,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: or killed in a lighting duty first responder. If they had a home, they'll pay the mortgage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: If they didn't have a home, they give them a home. And especially if it's a severely battle wounded,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: they give them a smart home because these poor guys come home with no limbs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And so the beauty of Steven and his selfless act was that he's now helped thousands and thousands

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: of people. I mean, the tunnel to towers is incredible. That's part of our mission is to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: bring awareness to these great people at tunnel to towers. What they do, they've raised $250 million

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to help protect the protectors, to rescue the rescuers in what's become unfortunately,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: a somewhat ungrateful society, but they will not forget these great guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So you tell Steven's story. He's one of the 20 people that you talk about in the new

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Iron Labs, 24 20 podcast series. If you can just linger on his story a little longer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: what does that tell you about the human spirit that this guy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you know, the tunnel couldn't drive through. So he just puts on that heavy pack and runs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: What do you make of that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: That shows the depth of a man's soul. He didn't have to do that. He could have turned around and

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: went home to his family and nobody would have shamed him. But he's one of those beautiful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: brave people that take a job that really doesn't pay a lot of money and you become a cop or a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: firefighter or nurse or an EMT or a medic or soldier or Marine, airman, sailor. When you take

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: these jobs, you don't do it for fanfare. You definitely don't do it for money. I mean, those

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: 13 brave souls we lost a week or two ago in Afghanistan, they're brand new soldiers and

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Marines. They make $22,000 an hour, but they don't work 40 hours a week. They work 80,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: they work 90 hours a week. So they make it about six bucks an hour. And you know what? They sign

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: up and firefighters and cops and medics and EMTs, nurses, emergency room doctors, they don't really

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: make a lot of money. I mean, they're starting salary right now for a New York cop. I was a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: New York cop for two years first. I made $12.25 an hour back in 1989 to get shot at during the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: crack wars. If you made $11 an hour with a family of four, you were entitled to welfare back then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So I was just above the welfare level, risk of my life. And these are the guys that are getting

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: ripped up now. And look, I won't get into any politics, but that says something about someone's

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: soul, that they're willing to take a job like that and get now, get zero respect. So a guy like

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Steven, what that shows is the depth of that man's soul and courage and determination.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It's hard to be selfless in this world anymore, but I still know a lot of selfless people that

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: just put on equipment every day, bulletproof vests, fire, bunker gear, stethoscopes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: flak jackets, military helmets, and they go in and they do it smiling. That young Marine that passed

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: last week, she was photographed and quoted as saying, I have my dream job as she was holding

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the left-hand baby. And she was dead a few days later. She was so tired of being a little girl,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: she was so thrilled to be making $7 an hour helping people. Isn't that huge? That to me says,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that's a true sign of character right there. And it's important for our society to elevate those

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: people as heroes. Let me ask you about firefighting. What do you think it means to be a great firefighter

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and a great man, a great human being in a situation like you were in in 9-11?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You know, that's kind of a broad term. You can go to different firehouses and they might have a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: different definition of what they consider a great firefighter. But I think in the industry as a whole,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: if you're willing to put everyone else before you, especially your team, as we say, there ain't no

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I in team, right? It's T-E-I-M and there's no I in there. It's all about those guys and girls next

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to you. If you can do that, that makes you pretty great. You put everything else second, then you

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: just run in and you run in with that team for strangers. I've had the honor of being a firefighter

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and the honor of I spent almost 25 years of my adult life serving humanity, my country, my former

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: city. And the people I worked with were giants. And I don't mean that in height, I mean, but I

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: mean that in spirit and in soul. I saw some of the most heroic selfless acts. And then I saw some of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the behind the scenes that were so impressive. We'd go to a fire around Christmas and the family

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: would lose everything. And even when I was a cop, same thing, you come back either to the police

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: precinct or the firehouse or the EMS station. And someone would put together a collection and say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: hey guys, hey Lex, 50 bucks a man. The Smiths down the street just lost everything. We're going to go

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: get some presents for the kids and some turkeys. And not one of those guys questioned that. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: they were making 12.25 an hour and they still came up with 50 bucks for that family. But see,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that's the stuff the press won't show you. They don't want to show that humanity, that soft edge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: See, when you're a warrior, you need to have this rough shield, this rough exterior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Cause if you don't, you die. But a true great firefighter or a responder or a cop or military

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: personnel, they have that rough exterior with that soft on their belly, that heart. And that's to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: me the true great ones. Some of them, they just have a hard time doing that. There's no shame in

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: showing your soft side. Well, you got your dad to say, I love you back. No, that was huge. That

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: took me 22 years, Lex. So you were a firefighter for 21 almost 22 years. Why did you become a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: firefighter? Oh my dad. I mean, I was five years old and I went to his firehouse and then there was

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: these, at the time they look like giants to me with mustaches and the trucks, trucks smell like

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: smoke and the gear smell like smoke and the tires and the diesel fuel. And that one was like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: this is what I'm going to do. And then they bring you in the kitchen and they stuff you with ice

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: cream and cake and everything. And then I go home to my mom, shaking with a sugar corn. She's mad

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: at my dad. But yeah, it was just, oh, I was like, I got to do this. They were like a baseball team

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: in a garage with a truck and these big tools and big coats and helmets. And they were just laughing

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and having fun. And I'm like, yeah, man, I'm doing this. And I knew, I was obsessed with it. I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I was so pissed that the fireman's test came out when I was 14 and I couldn't take it. You had to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: be 18. And it was done, test was graded and whatever. So my dad, now there's a copy circulating

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: because it's old now. And he goes, yeah, yeah, this is what you're in for. And I took it and I

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: did it like it was real. And I got a 99. I was so pissed. I said, I want to get hired. He goes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you can't, you're 14. But I just wanted to do it so bad. And I just wanted to help people. I just

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: wanted to be like my dad. He'd come home smiling, as tired as he was. And he fought fires in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: 60s and 70s when the city was burning. And he's still as exhausted as he was, he'd still be smiling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I wanted to smile at work. And I used to, I got paid to laugh and joke. I got paid to cry sometimes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But man, we laughed a lot. We really, it was the chop breaking. It's just unending and it's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: If you don't mind, can you tell me you were really kind enough to give me one of these shirts with 114?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Can you tell me the story of 114, of Tally Ho?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I wear, proudly, I served eight years in that command and I didn't finish my career there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I passed the lieutenant's test. And once you do, you have to leave.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: The story behind Tally Ho is back in World War II, there was this gentleman named Bad Jack Carroll.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And Jack was an airborne ranger. And my father-in-law was also on the department and he knew Jack.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And Jack came home, Jack jumped Normandy and stormed up through the Battle of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Bulge in Bastonia. And he came back, greatest generation as they all did. And they got jobs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And they went right to work and they were treated better back then, vets. And he got on the New

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: York City Fire Department and he got assigned a ladder 114. And they first got radios back then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And when Jack, he would drive the truck. You're up there with the officer, the lieutenant or captain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So the boss is off the truck, you operate the radio for them as the driver. So when they call

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: them and they'd say, ladder 114, respond in the 52nd Street, 3rd Avenue, Structure Fire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You're supposed to get back and say, ladder 114, 10-4. But he refused to do that. He'd say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: ladder 114, Tally Ho. Because that's what they'd yell when they jump out the plane.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So all these years later, it's stuck. And it's a little bit of a bragging right, but out of 350

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: engine and truck companies in the whole New York City Fire Department, we're pretty much the only

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: one that's called by their nickname on the radio, not their number. So it tweaks some guys off in

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: other places. They may, F you, Tally Ho. But it's just, yeah, it's a great, great heritage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And we're really proud. And Shamrock, he was Irish and a lot of the guys back then were Irish

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: immigrants from the area, from the neighborhood. And they would actually take the fire truck to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: church on Sunday and park out front. And one guy would stay in it to hear the radio in case they

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: got a call. So yeah, that's the proud history. And you said that if I wear this around New York,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: am I getting a little bit of- You might get a guy from the Bronx,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: go, hey, Tally Ho, screw you. But I mean, it's all that good rivalry. We like to kid each other back

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and forth. Guys from Manhattan will say, yeah, you guys in Brooklyn, yeah, short buildings,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: tall stories. And we're like, yeah, but you guys in Manhattan, tall buildings, no stories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It's all that jocular ball breaking. It's good stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Let me ask, I guess, a difficult question. If we just step back on the events of 9-11,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: on the side of the people that flew into the towers, what do you take away from that day

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: about the nature, about human nature, about good and evil? How did that change your view of the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I witnessed evil firsthand. I remember later on well into that night when we were

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: trying to help get those police officers out, I remember looking up at the building,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: century 21, the store runs along the east side of the towers and it was still there. And the debris

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: had come down right almost to the edge. Century 21 is this old story department store in New York

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: City. And the sign was there and it was still lit up. Some of the neon was broken, but I think some

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: of it was actually still lit up. And I just looked around and I was like, this is a war zone. We're

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: at war. And we knew we were attacked. We heard the fighter planes. And back then it wasn't the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: extensive communication network. And we had cell phones, but they were the old school flip phones

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and there was no news on them. And so, plus we didn't have a signal down there anyway. I couldn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: reach my family for like 12, 13 hours. And my dad had deployed down to the ferry terminal to retrieve

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: bodies. He was retired, but he still went. And they deployed him to go be basically the morgue

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: transport guys. They expected to be sending hundreds and thousands of bodies across on the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: ferry. And they set up these tractor trailers as a mobile morgue. And that never happened because

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: there were no bodies to take. They were all buried. So it's so evil firsthand. I don't know how

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: someone can inflict such revenge or a vengeful act in the name of anything, in the name of a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: religion, in the name of a cause, in the name, like what the hell? Were you ever able to make

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: sense of that? Why men are able to commit such acts of terror in the days and the years after?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: No, Lex, I haven't. My mom's from Ireland and I still have a lot of family there. And my great

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: uncles, one of them was dragged out and shot. He lived, but just based on a rumor that he was in

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the IRA. And I wasn't happy to see what happened to my mom's people because they were victimized

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and brutalized by England at that time. But blowing up bombs and killing innocents in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: name of that, it doesn't make it right. I couldn't justify something like that. I can see,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I was a cop, I was a soldier, and you never want to take life in those jobs, but sometimes you have

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to, but you don't do it with a vengeance. You don't do it with a thirst. You do it because it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: necessary for survival. When you do it out of a blood lust, out of a thirst, out of a cause,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: out of a thirst, out of a cause, that's evil. There's something wrong with you. I respect life

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to the highest level. Life is sacred to me. It's precious. It's beyond. It's not a commodity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It's a gift. But to take life just so randomly, so there's something way wrong with that person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And maybe I'm a conflicted soul, but I would have no problem seeing someone like that put to death

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: because they do not deserve life. There's many children around this world that are being taught

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to hate someone who's different than them just because the person who's allegedly teaching them

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: says so. I don't understand it. Well, that starts with just having a basic respect and appreciation

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: of other human beings, and that starts with empathy. And one of the reasons I love this country,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: while joking that I'm Russian, maybe you could say the same as you being Irish,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you're actually truly an American, and that's why I consider myself very much an American.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And one of the reasons I love this country is it serves as a beacon. I still believe it serves as

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: a beacon of hope and that empathy and love for the rest of the world, that hate is not going to get

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you far, that love will get you a lot farther. And I still think sometimes it's easy to see the press,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: mainstream media, you could see social networks, because you can make so much money on division.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Sometimes because it makes so much money, it's easy to think we're really divided. I honestly

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: don't think we are. That's just the very surface level thing that we see on Twitter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It's that you're 100% right. There's people out there that are maximizing off this whole division.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They want us divided. They want people angry because it sells. A lot of these people that

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: are in charge of certain organizations, well, they all seem to have nice cars and nice houses

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and nice vacations. And they're constantly trying to convince everybody that we hate each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: To me, I'll use a fireman analogy. It's like a little campfire. And if you just let the embers

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: flutter, they'll go out. But if you take a little cup of gasoline with those embers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it'll blow right up in your face. And that's what a lot of these politicians and a lot of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: these media folks are doing, because there's something in it for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I think it's possible to defeat them with great leaders, with great spokespeople,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: with great human beings having a voice. One of the powerful things with the internet

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: is more and more people have a voice. And I ultimately believe, certainly in America,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but in the world, the good people outnumber the assholes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Oh, I agree. There's days when I think the assholes are overrunning us. But you know what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I think what the downfall of the world is, is ego and arrogance. And people that think they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: better than that other guy. My parents raised me to be this way. My mom is such a sweet, gentle

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: soul. She's an immigrant. She came here at 16 years old. She helps everybody but herself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: She's just one of those people. She's sick. She's got Parkinson's. You'd never know it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And she's still flying around her condo complex helping everybody, because that's what she does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: She loves to help people. But she's been a great leader. She's been a great leader.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: She's been in the shoes of people. But she's been in their shoes. She's been poor. She's sick. Her

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: husband was sick. She's had all sorts of suffering and loss in her life. My granddad died when my mom

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: was 10, and she was one of 10 children that survived out of 14. She knows hard times,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but she so appreciates the good times and the goodness of this country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: The fire department and the police department, military, told me a lot about empathy and trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to really feel for someone and put yourself in their situation. I remember years back,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I was a much younger fireman. I probably had five years on the job. I was sent down to the next

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: firehouse over to fill in. We would get sent around randomly when they needed an extra guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And someone came banging on the firehouse door, and in the tenement apartment next door, they said

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: there was an older woman that was unconscious. So we dispatched ourselves and we ran over with

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the medical kit. And it was an elderly woman laying there on the bed, and she was obviously

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: not breathing. She was obviously in cardiac arrest, and an older gentleman that was

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: holding her hand just inconsolably crying. And it turned out it was her husband, and they were

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: married for 65 years. And normally, we would just respectfully ask the family members to just step

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: aside and let us do our work. And I realized that he wouldn't leave her side. So I kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: gave the crew a wink, and they were doing CPR on what they had to, and I just let him keep holding

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: her hand. And I said, sir, could you just come over just a little bit so we can work? And I held

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: his hand as he held hers, and I said, sir, do you have faith? And he did. And I said, would you like

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to pray with me for your wife? And he said, I would like to. So we said the Lord's Prayer, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I just asked God to protect her and bless her. And I think he realized that she didn't have a chance,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but we still gave her that chance, and we got her in the ambulance. And maybe it was wrong to try to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: make it look like we could save her, but you can't really not try. But the one beautiful moment was

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: he thanked me, and he was almost okay with it at that point. He wasn't as upset, he wasn't as

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: distraught, because I tried to just humanize that situation of what we were trying to do. We were

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: trying to do our best, but we also tried to be compassionate to his sadness. And I walked away

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: just feeling so good, even though it was a tragic situation and she did pass, that he came by to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: thank us days later. It's just heartbreaking, but it just happens many, many times throughout the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: country every day. People get that opportunity as a responder to be that last bridge to the family

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and the loved one. And you only get that opportunity once sometimes, and you really have to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: To me, it's like your moment to shine. You could just be very, very dismissive and very rude,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: or you could be compassionate and just show, hey, I have a mom, I have a grandma,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: just in your mind, pretend that that's who you're working on and that's who you're with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So that moment of compassion, that moment of empathy, even if it's brief,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: can be the thing that saves the person from suffering,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: make the difference between suffering and overcoming in the face of tragedy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yes, I felt that even though obviously his loss was still huge, it just made it a little more

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: bearable and tried to just take his grief down to a lower level. And it made me feel

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: really good about doing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: That's a powerful way to see the job of a first responder. Of course, you have to deal with

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: certain aspects of the tragedy, but it's to provide somebody with that moment of compassion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yeah. And I made it a little habit because sometimes with faith, it's a little bit of a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: tricky subject. So every time I had someone who died, which unfortunately was many, many times,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I would just touch their hand and just say a little quick prayer and just say, look,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I hope you're moving on to a better place. I hope if you did have faith that it's strong as you

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: depart. And if you didn't have faith, I hope maybe at your last moment that you found that

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you found some and you just found some closure. So that was just my little ritual, I think. I felt

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it was important that that person, even though they were a stranger, just had someone there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: just hoping for the best for them in their last moments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You mentioned cancer. You had a rare leukemia due to all the work that you did at ground zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Can you maybe talk to the experience of just breathing through those days and what that was

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: like being unable to breathe, being overwhelmed by all of the dust in the air?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yes. The first day, especially, we didn't have equipment. We didn't have breathing apparatus,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and then we were handed little 69 cent hardware store dust masks, those little thin paint masks

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that would just get sweated up and stick into your face within 30 seconds. So they were useless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And what you wound up feeling like was that you swallowed a box of razor blades because

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: there was glass and there was cement and it was just so caustic. And I remember that night,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: when we went back just to get some medical relief for the few hours, we were walking up the hill

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to the firehouse because they dropped us off like a block away down at engine 201s and quarters. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: one of the older firemen, as we're walking up the block, we're all struggling. We're all having a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: hard time breathing. I mean, I felt like I was dying literally. It was pretty bad. And just

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: remember the one guy going, now we're all dead. And I said, no, no, we made it. We made it. He

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: goes, no, you don't get it, kid. He said, we just breathe in poison after poison for hours. And then

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that went into days and then went into months. He says, we're all dead, man. This is going to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: take us all. And I thought he was crazy. And then now years later, starting in 03, 04, guys just

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: started coming down with these really rare and advanced cancers. And then it just stopped being

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: a coincidence with the number of guys. And they were young. One of the first guys, John McNamara,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: he was 33 or 34 and he came down colon cancer and it took him quickly to the hospital. And he was

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: in 2005. And I said to friends and family, I said, I feel like I'm running through a minefield and I

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: wonder when I'm going to step on my mind because everybody's going to get sick. And I wasn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: feeling well from 2008 on. I couldn't put my finger on it, but I just wasn't right. And then in 2011,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I failed my medical. My bloods came back horrifically wrong and they pulled me off the truck,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but they strung me out for a month. The doctors in the fire department, one of them said my spleen

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: was engorged because it was probably drinking myself to death like as he said, most of the guys

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: did after 9-11, which was pretty wrong of him and stereotyping, just to stereotype and to categorize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And the guy couldn't have cared less. He was so crude and nasty. And then my one doctor,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: who was my doctor on the outside, my blood pressure was 240 over 140. My spleen was about to rupture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: She didn't even show up for my appointment and I went down, passed out. The paramedics responded.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: She got into an argument with a paramedic because of her big ego and basically telling him there

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: wasn't really anything wrong. And he's looking at my paperwork going, this guy's got leukemia. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: he overrode her. He raced me out of there down to Brooklyn Methodist. And the doctor,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the charge physician, the ER physician, he says, you're not leaving because you're in a bad way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I said, well, what is it? He said, I need a little while to figure it out. He goes, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you probably have one of a few different types of leukemia. He said, I'll drill into your hip,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: take your marrow and find out. And he said, but in the meantime, we'll get the swelling on the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: spleen down, like some sort of rapid medicines and whatnot, because my spleen is about to rupture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I had no blood platelets left, which is your clotter. So I basically would have bled to death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I found out from my team of doctors that I had about 48 hours to live. And that really

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: set me off. I was infuriated because I was telling them for a long time that I was sick.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: The doctors failed you. The few doctors in the beginning failed you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I felt very betrayed and other guys had died. And I had it out with that one doctor. I basically

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: told her she was fired from my case and she's a pretty politically in charge person and I didn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: care. I jeopardized my job for it because it was my life. And I got the sense that it didn't really

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: matter to her. She didn't have any empathy, as you say. Well, the exact, so why for her, why for a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: few others? Was there not a special care, a special compassion for, first of all, humans, but human

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: beings in your position, especially a firefighter, a first responder? You know, Alex, I think what it

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: is in the department, their title is just to get us back to duty as quickly as possible when

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: we are either injured or sick because what happens then is your replacement is now in overtime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So you're out being paid on medical leave, but then they need to replace your spot and then that

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: costs more money. So I think it's just behooves them to get as many personnel back and especially

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: during the summertime, you know, they look at it like, oh, maybe you want a few extra days off to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you know, go to the beach. And this one doctor, he tipped his hand back as if like I was drinking

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: an alcohol beverage. He says, hey, busy summer. Because I asked him to look at my spleen, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: was sticking out of my abdomen like a football. And I said, excuse me, sir. I said, how dare you

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: assume that I'm abusing alcohol because, you know, alcohol abuse sometimes will present itself as

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the spleen is engorged and having an issue. So he automatically just assumed that that was my

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: situation. Wouldn't even give me an exam. And I was horrified. I was so angry. I mean, I wanted

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to punch this guy out. And I literally was screaming at him and an executive officer came in to defuse

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it and sent me to another doctor. And when I showed her my paperwork, she was horrified. She

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: was like, what did he say? And she said, oh, okay, go to your regular doctor tomorrow, who was one

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: of the department doctors. And she just, it was just an indifference. It was like, I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I was shocked at the lack of compassion. But you know what? That being said, I'm past it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I, you know, life moves on. The team of doctors, I ended up with a Methodist and my subsequent

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: oncologist, Dr. Peter Menzel, world-class, just incredible human being. My Dr. Pete is just,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I love him. I just, I love him like a friend, like a big brother, like a father, like a,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: my primary oncology care nurse, Mike Nunez, was just incredible human being. And he knew I was

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: frightened because I had to get two and a half years of chemo compressed into seven days or I

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: was dead. These massive bags of chemo that never stopped. And they burn, the minute they went into

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: your body, you felt like you were burning to death from the inside out. And Mike, when Mike came in

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to hook me up, he said, look, I have to wear a hazmat suit. This stuff is so caustic that if it

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: drips, it'll burn whenever it touches. And I was like, but Mike, you're going to put that in my

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: body. How the hell is it not going to kill me? He says, no, no, this is exactly what it's supposed

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to do. Trust me. So when he prepped the IV tube to get it flowing, it spilled onto the tube and the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: tube started to smoke and burn. And I said, no effing way, Mike, you're not putting that in me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: No way, no way. And he goes, listen, let me get another one. Let me start it over. And here he is

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: wearing a hazmat suit, looking at me and I'm going, this is insane. And he goes, he looked at me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: he took my hand and he says, Nells, if you don't take it, you're dead. He says, you got those three

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: kids. I'm sorry, I have no other option. You're dead. And I said, all right, Mike, okay. And he

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: hooked me up. And you know what? It was like, if you do drink alcohol and you have like a shot or

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: one strong type spirit and you start feeling that burn, well, the minute he hit me in the vein,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it just started going up my arm, burning and then up my shoulder, across my neck, into my head,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: across the rest of my body, within a minute down to my feet. And I was writhing in pain for seven

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: days and I was praying to die. I was the seventh rescuer in six months to come down with the rarest

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: leukemia there is. There's only 500 cases in all of North America a year. And seven of us came down

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: in six months. Two guys died during treatment. Seven responders, police fire. Two guys died in

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the first couple of days of the treatment because it's so vicious. Your liver, your heart, your

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: kidneys, something will fail. And I was praying and I was praying, but I wanted to die. I was in so

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: much pain. And I wouldn't take a painkiller because I know people with some issues and I just didn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: want to go there. And finally on the last day I gave in, I said, please, I can't do this anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I was literally like jumping out of my skin and they gave me something, but it had burned out my

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: mind. It burned out my body. I couldn't hear. I could barely see. It was vicious, but it worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And my nurses especially, they just, it was so dedicated and devoted. And I was not an easy

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: patient because I was in a lot of pain. It was bad. And it drove my friends, my family crazy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was just, it wasn't good. But on that first night, I had a quick vision of all these people

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that I loved that were dead, that died. A lot of them in the trade center. And I saw Johnny. I saw

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: friends I grew up with. The last one was my mother-in-law who had passed six months before

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and she died of, she was in a coma. She had a stroke. She had a horrible, horrible last six

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: months of life. And she wasn't fair because she was so religious. She went to church every day,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the Val Catholic woman. And all of a sudden I see her and she's smiling. And we used to talk a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220
