body.input: It's the Irish thing, like the gab, the gift of gab. And she used to call me her boyfriend

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: because we'd sit and talk for hours and talk about books and about movies and about food.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I loved her. She was my friend. And she'd say, my boyfriend's here. And all of a sudden she's

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: smiling and she goes, hi, my boyfriend. I says, Nan, Nan, what are you doing? She goes, he's not

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: ready. He doesn't want you. You got to go back. You got things to do. And I'm like, no, Nan, Nan,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it hurts so much. Please, please take me. And she laughed. She goes, no, no, not yet. I'll see you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And she just faded away. And one of my doctors on my team, she had a problem with religion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And that's okay. I understand that. I'm not a preacher. I have a faith, but I don't preach it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I don't push it. I just live and let live. So she sent in this shrink to see me. And I was

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: messed up from the chemo, but I knew what I was seeing. I knew what I was saying. And he was a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Jewish gentleman. He was a rabbi also in a synagogue. And I actually had responded in that

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: district and he knew 114 would run into Borough Park. Oh yeah, I see Tally Ho. They come down the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: street. And he asked me to tell him the story and I did. And he started laughing and he scared me

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: now. I said, doc, am I really crazy? He said, no, no. He said, I believe you, my friend. He said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: we share the same God. He goes, we work in the same corporation, but in different departments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Different departments. I like it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He says, you did see your mother-in-law. He says, your faith is that strong. He said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I've had many patients express the same sentiments. He said, so I want you to listen to her and fight

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and be strong. And he said, so what else do you want to talk about? I said, well, doc, am I that

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: messed up? He goes, no, no. He goes, they're paying me for an hour. It only took 20 minutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So we watched the Yankee game together. But it was just, again, it showed the human condition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Here's these two men of two totally different faiths. And yet we shared that bond of faith

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and he had empathy and he had sympathy. And he saw me and many other patients. So he just didn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: assume. And he gave me a fair shake. And I will always be grateful to him for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Through any of this, the pain you had to go through with the leukemia, but also the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: days of 9-11 after, did your faith get challenged?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You know, it was strange. It was times it was so angry. There's that range of emotions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the anger, the denial, the depression, the this, the that. And this is the weirdest thing. It was

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: mostly, I knew my career was over and they retired me out of the job. I got sick in August and that

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: October they told me I was out. And by the time I was processed and used up my leaves and whatever

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you want to say it was, I was officially retired in January of 02. And it was less than six months.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I'm there walking my dog one day, my rescue Greyhound, who I miss. She was such a soul. God,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: she lived to be almost 13, Katie. And we're walking in the snow and I got the call. I was retired.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I looked at her and I'm like, Katie, what am I going to do? And she just looked up and said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: we're going to go on a lot more walks. And I was so sad. And I was so sad. I was so angry

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: because I lost my priesthood. I loved helping people. I really, like I would have done it for

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: free. I would never tell Mayor Bloomberg that, right? He's all about the buck, right? But like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: honestly, I would have been a New York City fireman. I would have paid them to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I wasn't allowed anymore. That's it. You have over 20 years and you have cancer. Back when my

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: dad got sick, they'd let you hang around for 10, 12 years in an office, but not now. Now it's all

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: about the bottom line. But I was more depressed about losing a job than almost losing my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Like as crazy as that sounds, you know? And it just-

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was more than a job. I mean, it's a way of life. It also is your family, your father,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: your carrying torture, your father's- Oh, my friend. I love my friends. I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: we work 24 hour shifts together. You cook, you clean, you break each other's jobs relentlessly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I mean, I love those guys so much. I mean, I hope that my kids and anyone that I know and care about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I hope they can experience the bond of that brotherhood that I experienced in my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It was so, God, I would give anything to have it back. Just, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Can I ask you about New York? So unfortunately, I've never lived in New York. I've visited. I've

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: always wanted to live there for a bit. Obviously, it's a very different experience to have really

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: lived in New York for many, many years, but there's a few friends of mine that are from,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: they got similar accent as yours, that are a little bit saddened. Perhaps it's temporary, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: perhaps not. They don't seem to think so of what New York has become, especially with COVID.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It's losing some of the spirit of New York. Do you have that sense? Do you have a hope for

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: this city that has been so defining to what is America?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: My heart's broken. I had moved to New Jersey many years ago, but I still have close attachment to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: New York. My parents are still there, many, many family members. And I've since now moved to Tennessee.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I needed to go somewhere quiet. I wanted to heal my fractured soul. And I'm in the middle

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: of a beautiful farming rural area in middle Tennessee. And so they probably called me a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: sellout back in New York for leaving, but it's not the same city. And it's sad. I'll refrain from the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: politics and the finger pointing, but it's a mess compared to what it was. And I did Broadway

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: theater security for many years. And I started to see it slide with stuff that was happening,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: public urination and defecation. And just like, tourists don't want to see that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I had an unfortunate incident two years ago. I was jumped by four teenagers coming off the subway

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and they were pissed off because I was wearing an American flag hat. And I don't know, I'm not really

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: sure why, but it left me, I got out of it. Okay. But I was taken back. They were literally videoing

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it. And the kid was just throwing shadow punches at my face wanting to beat me up. And I finally

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: looked him in the eyes and I was like, Oh boy, I'm a little too old for this. And the body's a little

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: broken down for chemo. And I finally just said, all right, I just had enough. I wanted to go home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Just worked a 17 hour shift as a stagehand. And I was so taken back. I was so insulted. I'm saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I spent my life protecting this city and now I'm getting attacked for nothing. And I gave up and

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: maybe I should have given it a little more time, but it's, I don't know, it's turned into an angry

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: place. It's turned into, I think there's a lot of people that aren't getting the resources they need

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: in a sense. There's a lot of mental illness. There's a lot of homelessness. There's a lot of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: violent people just roaming around the streets and it's not good. It's not safe. And tourists are not

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: going to come back. Even just leading up to the COVID, I had some tourists say to me, I won't be

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: back. And now I can only imagine that it's just gotten exponentially worse. But I hope there's a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: chance it'll swing back because it is. It's the gateway to the world. I mean, my grandfather came

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: from Denmark. He landed in Ellis Island in the twenties. American success story, 25 bucks in

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: his pocket, didn't speak the language. Had a sponsor family in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, and he made it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He ended up dying owning a bakery at one point and then an apartment building. And he did pretty well

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: for himself for an immigrant who was poor. And my mom, my Irish mother landed in the same neighborhood,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, 16 years old. Worked as a cashier 50, 60 hours a week in a supermarket

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and finished school at night. Married my father to firemen and lived the American dream. And it

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: was all from New York. And my father's mom was from Irish immigrants and they all landed in Ellis

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Island, but my mom didn't because it was closed at that point. But there's people breaking down

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the doors to come to this country. There's no one breaking down the doors to leave. And this is a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: problem I have, but people that aren't grateful for being here. And this, again, it's not political,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: just straight down the middle fastball. If you don't like it here, I'll show you the door.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I'll get you the plane ticket. I mean, would you want to live back in Russia compared to here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Would you? You might because of family ties, but I mean, if you had no ties to Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: or would you want to go to China right now and possibly end up in a labor camp? Or right,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: there's people busting down the doors to get to this place. It's not perfect. It's got its flaws.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It's got its blemishes, but it's a damn great place. It's the best country in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yeah. And some of it, so first of all, I have hope for New York. I think that culture is very

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: difficult to kill. I think it will persevere. And I think ultimately the same story with New York

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: as with the rest of the United States, it has to do with leaders. And I'm always hopeful that great

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: leaders will emerge. I agree. And the kind of leadership we see now and the kind of conversations

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: we have now, I think it has to do with the prosperity and comfort. And in the face of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: hardship, I think great leaders will emerge. And I just think ultimately in the long arc of history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Well, leaders shouldn't become rich. They shouldn't become rich in the process. You

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: shouldn't go into political office as an alleged lunchbox kind of guy and then come out eating at

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the best steakhouse in the world. I mean, that's the problem with politics. My Irish grandmother,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: God rest her, used to say, oh, those politicians, they're all like dirty diapers. They're full of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: shit and they stink. And it's true. I don't give a crap what party they're in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yeah, greed and power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: We had to beg these guys, beg them for federal legislation to cover our medical bills. There's

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: a gentleman, John Field from the Field Good Foundation. This guy is a lion of a man, a general,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but with a soft, big, great heart. And John is a former construction worker who came to the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: 911 site the day after. He was one of those guys cutting the steel with torches and craning it out

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: of the air. One of those hard hats that just never got the credit and the praise that we did as

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: responders. And I don't mean that as a knock to responders. I mean, we lost 37 Port Authority

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: police officers, 23 NYPD officers, about a dozen emergency medical technicians and paramedics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: three court officers from New York State courts and two federal agents, and 343 New York City

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: firefighters. We lost a ton of responders. But the recovery workers thankfully weren't killed in

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that process. But there's hundreds of them now who are dead from illnesses because they came down

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to recover our people and the civilians and the poor lost souls that were killed at work that day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And John literally almost lost his foot in a construction accident at the site, an 8,000 pound

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: eye beam tore off half of his foot, ended up with massive sepsis, six months in the hospital,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: hundreds of thousand dollars in medical bills, and then no one wanted to pay him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So here's a guy, he's going to lose his house, lose his life, lose everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And now, the never forget, it started quick. And he went on a mission, formed his Feel Good

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Foundation. His last name is Feel, F-E-A-L, Feel Good Foundation. And this man literally went to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Washington, DC with his army, as he called it. And I was honored and blessed to be with him only a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: couple of times. I wish I had dedicated some more time to it. And what it was with John is he set

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: out on a mission to get, and initially what he did is he got funding to take care of responders

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: who were in that limbo, who couldn't get their medical bills paid, who couldn't make their

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: mortgages, who couldn't make their car payments, who couldn't make their childcare payments. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: John just took it upon his own to get donations and take care of you while you were suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I got a call when I got out of hospital, you okay? You need anything? I said, who is this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It's John Feel. I said, aren't you that construction worker? Yeah. You need anything?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I'm pretty good right now. I said, I appreciate it. Phone rang again a few weeks later. Hey,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: John Feel, you need anything? I'm like, this guy's incredible. But there's people who needed stuff,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and he was getting it done. And he, with his army, had to chase these politicians through

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the halls of Congress to get funding to cover the medical bills. I was getting sued for $125,000

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: for my month stay in the cancer ward. And I couldn't believe it. I said, well, wait a minute,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I have insurance. They're like, oh no, no, this is terrorism related. We don't cover that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: So usually then workers' comp will cover your on duty injury or illness. Oh no, no, no. Leukemia is

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: not covered under that. We don't cover that. So then the ping pong game starts, and I'm literally

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: have people showing up, taking pictures of my kids in front of the house. And I went and grabbed the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: guy one day by the collar. I said, who the hell are you? Sir, I'm a private investigator. We're

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: putting a lien on this property due to a non-payment of a bill. I said, okay, I understand. Do your job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Let me bring my kids inside, take all the pictures you want. Don't step on my front lawn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And I went in the house, I closed my room, my door, my door, my room, and I cried. I said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I can't believe this. I spent my entire adult life trying to help people give of myself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and I can't even get my medical bill paid. Well, John Field got my medical bill paid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He finally got these politicians with his team, firefighter Ray Pfeiffer, who has since died,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: fought with terminal cancer for nine years in a wheelchair. Literally at the end, he came out of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: hospice to go finalize getting us this coverage. Detective Luis Alvarez, who testified days before

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: he died in front of Congress, and a bunch of other guys that were really, really sick, and we had to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: shame these people into signing on. And luckily we had John Stewart come on and literally just

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: hound these guys and shame them and embarrass them. And what it all stemmed from was in 2006,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the first death that was determined to be linked to 9-11, there was others, but the first one that

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: was officially linked was a New York City police detective who initially, the city said he died of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: advanced lung disease. His lungs were protruding out of his body, and he was on painkillers. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it was so bad at the end that the doctor said, just grind them up, snort them, drink it, whatever

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you need to do to get instant relief. So when they found the talcum from the pill lining in his lungs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: they said, oh no, this is opioid abuse. He didn't die of lung disease. So they said, and the mayor

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: was quoted as saying, he is not a hero. Well, shame on you, Mr. Mayor. He was a hero. And his father,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: who was a retired police chief, married up with the Feel Good Foundation, and John Stewart,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and Ray Pfeiffer, Detective Alvarez. And they got us all covered. But it took so long. Lexi was so

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: heartbreaking. These people who were lining up three deep, politicians three deep to catch a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: picture with a responder so they can tweet, hashtag never forget, and hashtag look at me, and hey,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: how am I doing? All that bull crap. But they did nothing. They were nowhere to be freaking

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: found. I literally witnessed them hiding in cloak rooms, running down hallways away from us,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: those freaking cowards. That's cowardice. Can I just linger on the John Stewart thing, the comedian

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: actor John Stewart, his testimony before Congress over the benefits from 9-11 first responders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I mean, there's a lot of important human beings in this story, but he has a big voice. And he spoke

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: from the heart. What do you make of that testimony? Oh, it was heartfelt. I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: he spoke. Look, John was a polarizing guy, right? There's certain things like over the years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: he was cutting edge, and I might not have agreed with all of his- Oh yeah? Well, some stuff, some

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: not, right? But I tell you, I found him as funny. I enjoyed his humor. I would love the two of you

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to have a conversation. No, but again, I love a guy where you can have a difference in opinions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: That's the beautiful thing about the firehouse kitchen. I mean, it could get raucous and now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I don't know, it's a little different situation, but back in the day, some funny stuff. But yeah,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: John literally just took his talents. You would think he was speaking from the heart of a fireman

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: or a cop or a soldier or a Marine, someone who was there. But I think he especially got to know

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Ray so well. And Ray had this stack of mass cards from the funeral cards they give out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: It looks like a larger business card that's laminated. And Ray had a stack of them he would

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: carry around. I think it was close to a hundred cards. And John saw it and he said, what's that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: He says, these are my cards. He said, for what? He says, for my brother's funerals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And he was like, oh my God, you've been to that many funerals? He goes, yeah, this is just the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: ones I made. And John, I think, was just stunned. And John actually had that stack of cards after

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Ray passed and said, look at these. There's going to be more of these cards. We have one guy a week

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: or girl, one responder or recovery worker or someone who actually resided down there. There's

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: more than one a week dying. It's one a day dying on average. And on average, two people are diagnosed

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: with a 9-11 cancer or disease. Right now, the worst part is there's autoimmune diseases flying

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: off the graph and they're not covered under the legislation. By the grace of God, my cancer's

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: covered. If my cancer comes back, I mean, I'm in remission. It's technically incurable, but I've

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: been blessed I'm staying ahead of this stuff going on 10 years. But if it comes back with a vengeance

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: tomorrow and takes me, at least my wife will get my pension and be able to live her life without fear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But my friends who are suffering from these advanced autoimmunes, their wives get nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Their pension dies with them. And we're hoping that John and his army can shame these politicians

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: once again to have the kindness and decency to cover these autoimmunes. They're throwing a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: of money around at a lot of things lately, and this is one that they won't. And these are lives

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: in the balance who really need it. And John had this strong line. They did their jobs, do yours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Talking to the politicians. Yeah. And it's a strong wake-up call that

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it's not about the Twitter or the social media or all that kind of stuff. You have a job to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and you have to, it's that compassion implemented in the form of money, of helping people

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that were there for you when you needed help. Well, we had a guy, I mean, I might get audited

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: out of this one, I hope not. We had a congressman from out West, I won't say where, but he prided

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: himself on saying he was a retired cop. Busy cop, 22 years. He said no on the legislation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I witnessed a cop who was dying get out of his wheelchair and said, hey brother, I got a half a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: million dollars in medical bills and I'm a short timer. I got a few months to live. Who the F is

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: going to pay him? Do the right thing. You say you're a cop, you show me you're a cop and you sign

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that paper. And the guy started tearing up, the congressman, and he signed it, but he had to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: freaking shamed. And you know what he said? Well, this doesn't really confront me. This is pork as

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: far as my district is concerned. He goes, oh yeah? Do you know there's 10 guys from your district

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: who came across the country to help us that are also dying? He had no idea. He said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I don't know. He had no idea. And that's the sad part about Alex. It's a failure in leadership.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I mean, I think some people would vote for Mickey Mouse just because if he ran. I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I know offense against Mickey Mouse. I like him. He's a good guy, right? I mean, but like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: allegedly, supposedly. We don't know. Yeah. But seriously, I look at some of the leaderships

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: sometimes and go, we're in trouble. And also you lose, I think the way government is structured is

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: people who are senators or people who are in Congress, they start playing a game between

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: each other and they lose track of the connection to the people, to the basic humanity. So you forget,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: even when you think of yourself as a cop, you forget what are like the cops and the other people

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: servicing the community actually experiencing all the troubles they're going through and how they can

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: actually be helped because you lose touch of that because you're not actually living, you're not

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: talking to them, you're not living among them. And I mean, that's a natural part of the system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but I think that's why character and great leadership is important. As you say, you leave

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the game of Congress and you go back to the people. I mean, that's what the country, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it's like the George Washington ideal is you're not playing a game of power. You ultimately see

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: yourself as somebody who's servicing this country, servicing the community. And that requires talking

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to the people in their time of hardship. Well, you have some people, some people serving in

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: congressional districts don't even live in that district. I mean, so how are they going to empathize?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: They're not even driving through there on a daily basis. And, you know, again, when anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: becomes lucrative from a financial standpoint, it blurries people's vision. You have to take the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: potential of becoming rich out of politics. Politics is public service. Police and fire and

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: EMS are public service, but cops and firemen and medics don't walk out of their career with

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: a gazillion dollar contracts with this company and that company on that board of directors and

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: this board of directors. They walk out with a pension and that's it. And you have to wonder

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the intentions of people getting into politics. Are they truly going into to help the human

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: condition or are they trying to help their own damn condition with their wallet and their pocket

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: book? And I try to lean toward the latter lately, you know, with what I'm seeing out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Well, some of them are the good ones and that's our job as a society is to elevate the good ones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: That's it. And then, and that has to do with the ideals that we elevate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: There are a number of conspiracy theories around the events of 9-11. Do any of these hold true to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you or do they just frustrate you, even anger you? I've been asked this by a few different people in

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: my life. This is my take on it, right? You're a man of science and a man of education. So you-

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Allegedly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Allegedly, but yes, but you, you know, you're in a very, very intelligent man. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: what I believe took place is this, structural steel will fail at a sustained temperature of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: 1500 degrees Fahrenheit. And I don't know exactly how long that would have to be sustained,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: but that's the temp, right? Diesel fuel, kerosene fuel, kerosene-based jet fuel, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: was the ignition there, burns at 2200 degrees Fahrenheit. So that continued burning of that

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: diesel, that jet fuel, but kerosene-based, you know, it's all kind of similar, exceeded the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: temperature needed for that steel in the structural members of the trade center to fail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: In my heart of hearts, I would hate to ever think that somebody affiliated with our government,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: with some sort of agenda, would perpetrate that crime and that tragic, just destruction of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: humanity and property for some other form of gain. Those planes were rammed into those buildings at

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: 450 miles an hour. They were loaded with thousands and thousands of gallons of jet fuel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And it was an emergency generator in that complex, which had a 25,000 gallon tank of diesel fuel to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: continually run for weeks to keep the 911 system, the backup system going in the case of a

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: catastrophic event. Well, that tank in seven heated up from the fire that was already going on from

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: the aircraft debris coming into the building. So once that diesel became ignited in seven,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: now you had enough temperature to fail that steel in that building. So I would like to truly believe

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: what I've learned from the minimal fire science knowledge I have from my career, that it was just

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: a matter of it burned too long, it burned too hot, and it failed. I mean, if you look at the way it

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: came down, it came down as it was designed to in the God forbid event that it was to collapse. It

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: came down pancaking upon itself. If it had failed horizontally and just sprayed out side to side,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: those buildings would have dropped for a quarter, half a mile up to Canal Street.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: But you know, Lex-

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: The fire and the destruction that could have resulted from that is-

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Yeah. Oh my gosh, it could have been so much worse. I mean, you would have taken out every

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: building from that point all the way up. But in my heart, I'd like to just believe that it was just

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: a fire that burned too long and too hot. These planes caused structural damage upon impact in

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: both buildings, and it was just a matter of time. And then you think about it, you add all the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: plastics, all the carpeting, all of the stuff that was burning on those floors, you add that to that

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: fire load. I think it just had enough to collapse it. And you were in building seven for part of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: that day. I was just after it came down as well. We were aside it and we weren't in it or next to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it when it actually did come down, but moments after we were there. And again, I would like to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: believe that it was just that that fuel was going and it just took its physics, took its course,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and it failed. So physics and science aside, it's hard. It's both I would like to believe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: and it's hard to imagine that anybody would be so evil as to orchestrate parts of this

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: from within the United States government. That's very difficult for me to imagine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: You know what, there's people, and I won't elaborate, I won't get into any controversial

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: subjects, but what have you. There's some people that don't have any problem at all perpetrating

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: any level of evil. People like you and I who have hearts and we have depth of soul,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: we couldn't imagine it, but there's other people wouldn't even be a second thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I mean, I've seen some horrific incidents in my career that I go home shaking my head at night

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: going, human beings are just, they're not wired right. I mean, I look at animals, I love animals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I love dogs especially. And I see this dog park when I train to fly airplanes now and something

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I wanted to do. And there's a dog park across from the airport and there's 60 dogs and there's bones

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: flying up in the air and chew toys and sticks and they're running around having a time in their life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And they're all getting along and they're not hurting each other, they're not violating each

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: other, they're not canceling each other. And I'm going, we really need to learn from these

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: dogs. And I just, yeah, I mean, sometimes it sounds crazy, but I think they're better species

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: than people. Unless they're rabid, they don't hurt on purpose, they don't cut you off in traffic and

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: throw you the middle finger. They just don't do these acts of humanity that sometimes are so vicious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Why do you think these conspiracy theories of which there's a lot take hold? Why do you think

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: so many people believe some version of different conspiracy theories around 9-11?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Well, like many things in life, it leaves me a little conflicted. I have to say this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I am at the point now, I don't know who to believe anymore. So I could see that lending a hand to

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: someone who's already a doubter going, oh yeah, look, exactly, that's what they're doing. I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: look at this whole virus, who do you believe? Where did it come from? And if you plant that seed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it's like that little campfire we were talking about earlier. You just toss a little gas into

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: those embers, you got a fire now. I also think there's a lot of people with a hell of a lot of

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: extra time on their hands, and they're really bored. And when the two are combined.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Look, I was a three job Charlie, right? One guy used to say to me, anything but home. I go, no,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: I got deadlines, responsibilities. That's what it comes down to. We all have our hobbies and things

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: we like and little nuances, and that's what makes us special. We're unique. Every person is a unique

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: being. But I also think some people just, they want to cling to something. We all want to feel

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: accepted and belong to something. So all of a sudden you group up with these people and you

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: all believe this fervently like, yeah, yeah, yeah, they did it, they took it down, they took it down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: And now you start going, yeah. And I think what happens is when you're in company of people and

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you start telling each other the same thing often, you freaking believe it. I mean, if you keep

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: telling me I got a gray head of hair, I'm going to go, you know what? I do. But no, I don't. I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: right? I got that wave and bye bye do. But I think when you start hearing something often,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: you start believing it. But I'm not going to doubt their intelligence. I'm not going to doubt their

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: intentions, but I just don't see it as being plausible. It would be too big of an operation

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: to successfully happen. I mean, look, there's other things that, I won't say it on the interview

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: there, but I have my doubts with certain things that- I mean, conspiracy theories take hold for

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: a reason because some of them are true. No, yeah. The hard thing is just to know which ones is the

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: problem. Well, it's hard when you don't have facts, right? Or you don't know who to trust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: Sometimes when you don't have facts, when you don't have figures and you don't have science,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220

body.input: it's hard to take someone's word on it. I had a conversation with someone a while back, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niels Jorgensen: New York Firefighters and the Heroes of 9/11 | Lex Fridman Podcast #220
