metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He's an Austrian, the Austrian is deny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's the intriguing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He's from Austria, but he's not an Austrian economist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There are elements of the Austrian school of thought, which are worthwhile.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What is Austrian economics in this beautiful whirlwind picture that you painted?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Austrian economics grew out of the rebellion against the classical school.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you had three intellects who mainly led the growth of the neoclassical school back

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: in the 1870s was William Jevons from England, Menger who's from Austria and Vollrass from

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: France.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And Vollrass tried to work out a set of equations to describe a multi-product economy where

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: there's numerous producers and numerous consumers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Everybody's both a producer and a consumer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And you try to work out a vector of prices that will give you equilibrium in all markets

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: instantaneously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's his equilibrium orientation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Jevons is also on about equilibrium, but he worked more at the aggregate level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So this is supply curve and demand curve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's what Marshall ultimately codified.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Menger was pretty much saying that, well, yes, there might be an equilibrium, but you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: going to get disturbed from it all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You'll be above or below the equilibrium.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And what came out of the Austrian school was an acceptance of that sort of vision that

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: a market should reach equilibrium, but then said, well, you'll get disturbed away from

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the equilibrium.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's what gives you the vitality of capitalism because an entrepreneur will see

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: an arbitrage advantage and try to close that gap, and that will give you innovation over

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And Schumpeter went beyond that and saw the role of money and said that an entrepreneur

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: is somebody with a great idea and no money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So to become a capitalist, you've got to get money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And therefore, you've got to approach the finance sector to get the money, and the finance

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: sector creates money and also creates a debt for the entrepreneur.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And so you get this financial engine turning up as well, and you will get movements away

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: from equilibrium out of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You won't necessarily head back towards the equilibrium.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So Schumpeter has a rich vision of capitalism in which money plays an essential role, in

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: which you will be disturbed from equilibrium all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that is really, I think, a much closer vision of actual capitalism than anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: else by even the leading Austrians, Hayek, et cetera, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And certainly, Rombardo, I find totally like reading a cardboard cutout version of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: wealth of nations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's, I find his worth trivial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But Schumpeter was rich, but with the same foundations as the Austrians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But because he talked about the importance of money, that took him away from the Austrian

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: vision, which is very much based on a hard money idea of capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Schumpeter said you needed the capacity of the financial sector to create money to empower

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: entrepreneurs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's a very important vision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So Schumpeter's argument is the deviation from equilibrium, that's where all the fun

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: happens, that's where all the magic happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's the magic of capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And like the Austrians, because they focus on the deviation from equilibrium, they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: better than neoclassicals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But they still have this belief in the, you know, if you'll reach equilibrium ultimately,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: you'll head back towards it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Whereas they don't have an explanation of capitalism that gives you cycles apart from

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: having the wrong rate of interest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay, so there's no role for an accumulation of debt over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what Schumpeter gave us was a vision of the creativity of capitalism being driven

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: by entrepreneurs who are funded by money creation by the finance sector.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's fundamentally the world in which we live.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So there's also kids these days are all into modern monetary theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What's that about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay, modern monetary theory is accounting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I want to summarize it bluntly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's simply saying let's do the accounting, because what money is, is a creature of double

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: entry bookkeeping.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What's double entry bookkeeping?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Banks, this was invented back in the 1500s in Italy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I've forgotten the particular merchant who did it, based on some Arabic ideas as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But the thing is, if you want to keep track of your financial flows, then you divide what

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: you, all the financial claims on you, you divide into claims you have on somebody else,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: which are your assets, claims somebody else has on you, which are your liabilities, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the gap between the two is your equity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you record every transaction twice on one row.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay, so for example, if you and I do a financial transfer, you have a bank account, I have

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: a bank account, your bank account will go down, mine goes up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's the sum of the operation is zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But on the other hand, if I go to a bank and borrow money, then my account goes up, they

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: put money in my deposit account, the bank's assets go up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And still the same sum applies, assets minus liabilities minus equity equals zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now that's simply saying money is an accounting, a creature of accounting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's not a creature of a commodity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So if you think about how Austrians think about money, and how gold bugs think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: money and Bitcoin enthusiasts, if there are any left, think about money, what they see

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: is money is an object.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And you and I can both have more gold, if we're both willing to go to this mine somewhere

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: and dig a few holes and get a few specks of gold out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So there's no competition or no interaction between you and me if money is gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I think money should be an object, a commodity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But money fundamentally is not a commodity, it's a claim on somebody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's money as its essence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So when you do it, you must use double entry bookkeeping to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And then when you do, you find all the answers that come out of thinking of money as a commodity

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: are wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So for example, and I've got Elon on this one, so I want to get this with Elon because

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I saw him making a comment about this a few weeks ago on Twitter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He said that it's wrong for the government, effectively it seems wrong for the government

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: to always be in deficit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now, when you look at it and say, well, how is money created?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: How does money come about when it's not a commodity like gold, when you dig up out of

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the ground, when it's actually social relations between people that create money?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Well, money is the, fundamentally, the liabilities of the banking sector.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: If we make a transfer between us, your deposit account goes down, my deposit account goes

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Those are exchanges on the liability side of the banking sector.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But if we have a transaction with the bank, then if the bank lends us money, its assets

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: loans go up, its deposits go up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Again, that same balance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you've got to look and say, money therefore is fundamentally the liabilities of the banking

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: sector.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So how do you create additional liabilities?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You must have an operation which occurs both on the liability side and the asset side of

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the banking sector.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So if you and I make a new transaction, no money is created.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Existing money is redistributed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But if you go to a bank and take out a bank loan, then money is created by the bank loan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the liabilities of the banking sector rise, the assets rise, they're balanced, but more

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: liabilities means, or the banking sector means more money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So that's how private banks create money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's what I first started working on when I became an academic about 35 years ago,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the actual dynamics of private money creation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But the government has the same sort of story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: If the government runs a deficit, it spends more money on the individuals in the economy

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: than it taxes them, which means their bank accounts increase.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So a government deficit creates money for the private sector.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So that's where money creation occurs from the government.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So it puts more money into people's bank accounts by spending, by welfare payments

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: than it takes out by taxation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So that's creating new money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And then on the other side of the bank, the money turns up in the reserve accounts of

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the banks, which are basically the private bank's bank accounts at the central bank.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So rather than the asset of private money creation being loans, the asset of government

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: money creation is reserves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Money creation is a good thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you mentioned a bunch of stuff like private money creation with liabilities in the banks

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: and then how the government is doing, the reserves, blah, blah, blah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: At the end of the day, there's a bunch of printers that are printing money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And then you also said something interesting, which is social relations between humans is

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And you went to university to learn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It was about education.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I remember having a fight with my father once where dad was angry about the marks I was

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: getting for some of my courses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he said, if you don't get a decent result, you won't get a decent job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I said, I'm not here to get a job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I'm here to get an education.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Oh, wow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now the thing is, ultimately, it's been a pretty good job for me as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: This is in Sydney, by the way, and Sydney in summer is absolutely gorgeous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And what us bunch of lefties decide to do during summer, but read Karl Marx.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: On the beach or?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Actually, inside the room of the philosophy department at the University of Sydney in

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the main quadrangle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There's sandstone all around us and we, a bunch of about 20 or 30 of us reading our

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: way through Marx.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Capital, like which capital?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There's volume one, volume one capital.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I remember walking off to that meeting with one of my friends who's a law student.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And this was a period of a huge construction boom in Sydney.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the whole skyline, which we could see from the campus, was full of what they call kangaroo

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: cranes, which were an Australian invention.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That are cranes that can be leapfrogged over each other to build a skyscraper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So here you are reading Karl Marx, looking at the mechanisms of capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I looked at those mechanisms and I knew Marx argued that labor was the only source of value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he said, machinery doesn't add value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the cranes are worthless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I'm looking at these cranes and thinking, I want a very good explanation by Marx as

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: to why these cranes don't add value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So reading through the first seven chapters of capital, what you found was Marx applying

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: this dialectic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And like the ficti and stuff is bullshit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That is not how Marx thought at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I was reading, trying to find the thesis, antithesis, synthesis, and it's not there

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: at all in any of Marx's works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I read everything he's ever written on economics from 1844 to 1894 when his last

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: books were published.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There's not one word of mention of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What he does talk about is foreground and background and tension.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And his idea of a dialectic is that there is a unity will exist in society and that

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: unity can be individual, there can be a commodity, anything at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The unity will be understood by that society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: One particular aspect will be focused upon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So if you think about the human being in capitalism, the focus on the human being as an object

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: is their capacity to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You're a worker, okay?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That gets put in the foreground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The fact that you're human and you want to play a guitar and go surfing and make love

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: and all the other things that humans do is pushed into the background.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There's a tension between the two of those and that can transform that unity over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's a beautiful dynamic vision of change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So dialectics is a philosophy of change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So synthesis, antithesis is what does every idea have a counter argument?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There's a positive and negative and you bring them together somehow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And then Marx says this foreground, background, and tension.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Foreground is all what we think of as economics and background is all the lovemaking we do

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: as humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That sort of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And why is there a tension?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Because if you imagine the unity, like if you take a human in any preview, because you

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: go back to Cro-Magnon days when we're living in caves and we've got to go hunting and cook

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: food and stuff like that, but there's no social hierarchy as we've become used to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you don't get labored as a worker or a capitalist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You're just a human in that situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Then you've got more an integrated view of who you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I think that's one of the appeals of a genuine tribal culture that you get treated

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: for the whole of who you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You've certainly categorized your male, your female, your young, your old, you're a hunter,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: a tool maker, et cetera, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But you're treated as a more integrated object.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: When you get put in a complex society like a capitalist society, then one side of you

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: is emphasized and the others are de-emphasized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So is it fair to say that the background is like our basic fundamental humanity and the

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: foreground is the machine of capitalism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Effectively.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And when you look at it in terms of a human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But what Marx did is apply this to a commodity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So he said, what is the essential unity in a capitalist economy?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And the essential unity is a commodity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The essential unit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The essential unity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What's unity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Unity is an object in society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So he started from the point of view of trying to understand how exchange occurs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: How do we set prices?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he's starting vision was to say that a commodity is a unity in a capitalist economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The part of the unity that we focus upon is the exchange value, a capitalist produces

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: a commodity not because of its qualitative characteristics, but because it'd be sold

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: for a profit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the foreground aspect of a commodity is its exchange value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The background aspect of it, it won't succeed as a commodity unless it has a use value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the background is the utility thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So if you made something which didn't work, okay, then you might be able to sell it, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: it has no utility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You can't make that into a commodity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: A broken thing can't be sold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Does that have the subjective?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah, it has to have the subjective side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So people enjoy it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: As well as the objective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the objective is what capitalists worry about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I'll give you my favorite counter example of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I was in, I took a bunch of Australian journalists to China way back in the period when the Gang

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of Four was being on trial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And we did a tour of the Forbidden City in Beijing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And at that stage, all the artifacts of the royal family, the emperor, were actually in

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the building still.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And we walked past one of them and it was this gold, solid gold bar about this long,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: shaped like a fist, turned over like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And on this side, there were rubies, emeralds, diamonds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You'd never seen gemstones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I mean, gems that big.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And one of the journalists asked me what I thought it was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I said, oh, it's obvious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's a back scratcher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Ha, ha, ha.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I walked away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: She caught up with me about 20 minutes later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I said, I asked one of the guides, it is a back scratcher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So here's a back scratcher for the emperor made of solid gold with diamonds and rubies

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: and emeralds during the scratching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now that's a commodity in a feudal society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The cost doesn't matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You want the most elaborate, beautiful thing because you are the emperor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So in that feudal society, the commodity, what's focused upon is the utility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And the cost of production when you're the emperor is immaterial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Capitalism reverses that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the commodity in a capitalist economy is a plastic $2 scratcher you can get from Kmart

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: or Target.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And so the use value is necessary but irrelevant to forming the price.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now that was a completely different vision of exchange in capitalism to what I found

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: in the neoclassical theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Because that says it's the marginal utility and the marginal cost of everything that determines

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the exchange ratio.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And the crazy thing about that is not so much the marginal utility, but the argument in

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the neoclassical theory is that the price ratio, the price will, when there's an exchange

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: going on, there's two person, two commodity exchange of two commodities between two people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: They will, the price will change until such time as the ratio of the marginal utilities

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: is equal to the ratio of the marginal costs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's supposed to be the equilibrium.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And Mark says that's bullshit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's a previous society where you exchange stuff that you happen to have for stuff somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: else happened to have without any real production mechanism being involved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he said that's like when you have two ancient tribes meeting for the very first

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: time and one tribe can make something the other tribe can't make.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And they will therefore, the price they were willing to pay reflect how unique this other

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: object is that this one tribe can make and the other can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So for example, the story of Manhattan being sold for 40 glass beads, it's actually 40

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: glass trading beads.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I believe it is a true story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But the thing is the Indians couldn't make glass beads.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So they valued the glass beads in the island of Manhattan, okay, which is a utility-based

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: comparison.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What Mark said, that's the very initial contact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Over time, even if you don't know the technology, over time you start to realize how much work

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: goes involved in making what they're selling you versus what you're selling to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And you start making stuff specifically for sale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So Elon's not losing personal utility each time a Model 3 goes out the door.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He might get utility out of the fact that he's created that vehicle, that concept, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: manufactures it and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But he's not losing utility each time a Model T Ford goes out the door, going back for the

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: ancient commodity there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The advanced economies would be first to go through the revolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The socialist, the primitive economies would have to go through a capitalist transition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And this is the difference when the Mensheviks and the Bolsheviks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the Mensheviks and Hyman Minsky came out of the Menshevik family.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The Mensheviks believed you had to go through a capitalist phase.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Russia had to go through a capitalist period before it becomes socialist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The Bolsheviks believed they could get there in one go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Bypass the capitalist phase, do the development under socialism rather than under capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And this is what Janos was actually analyzing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You start from a primitive feudal economy, very little industrialization, and you want

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: to jump to an advanced industrial society from that foundation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So he said what you have then for is a whole range of industries, all of which need as

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: much resources as you can get for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you want to develop agriculture, mining, industry, every little division of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: They all have legitimate demands on the resources of the country and the state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That means that all your resources are fully employed and are probably over employed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you have a resource constraint in that society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The easiest way to cope with a resource constraint is to produce last year's commodity, not to

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: innovate, not to make change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what they will give you is as you start to add, you invest so you now have the beginnings

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of a steel industry, beginnings of a car industry and so on, you start investing, but you continue

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: producing the same product you made last year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I have a perfect personal example of that, which I'll throw in now if you like, a pretty

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: heavy conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I know my first major girlfriend had a brother who wanted to get a motorbike, but he couldn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: afford a Honda or a Kawasaki.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: At the time they cost about $3,000 for a 650cc Japanese motorbike.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He found he could buy a Cossack for $650, $1 per cc.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So I was there when they got...

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: $1 per cc, I like it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: This is in suburban Sylvania waters in Sydney.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So this crate arrives with the Cossack motorbike inside it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So we take it apart, it's then got all these wooden palings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: We have to pull off the wooden palings to open it up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And there's oil-soaked rag over this thing which is tied on a wooden base.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: We take the oil-soaked rag off and we stare in all its glory in a 1942 BMW.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It was exactly the same as Steve McQueen in the Great Escape.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the Russians for 30 years were making the same bloody motorbike.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It had a bicycle seat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's how they coped.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: They just made the same damn machine every year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And they said, so that's the outcome, you actually want the best possible world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You're trying to build as fast as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You're paying workers as high wages as you possibly can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that leads to a world where you don't innovate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: They said capitalism on the other hand, pure capitalist economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You're trying to pay workers as little as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You have competitive industries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You're trying to take demand away from your rivals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You have Kawasaki versus Honda versus BMW, et cetera, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The way you get demand away from your competitors is by innovating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what you will get is cycles and booms and slumps, but you'll innovate and change over

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what you found was this huge gap between socialist volume production with no innovation

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: and capitalism with innovation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So that was the fundamental failing that Janos Kornasoi saw, why did socialism not innovate?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Because if you go back to his famous historical incident with Khrushchev in the United Nations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: bangs Texophi Shewan, bangs the desks, says, we will bury you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He literally meant we're going to bury you in commodities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: We're going to produce more output than you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he was wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Because fundamentally in the long term, to bury somebody in commodity production, you

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: have to innovate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And like there's also, there's another remarkable Soviet engineer who was given the job of interpreting

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Marx's ideas of industrial sectors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So he had the commodity sphere, the industry sphere, sector one, sector two, sector three,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: sector one producing consumer goods, sector two producing capital goods, sector three

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: producing luxury goods for capitalists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And so he had a three sector model of the economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he was talking about the dynamics between them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And what Feldman did was reinterpret this as an engineer would reinterpret it, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: was brilliant work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what he said was, you need to produce the means of production.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: If you want to grow quickly, you focus on producing the means of production rather than

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: commodities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you don't make cars, you make car factories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You make a few cars, but most of the effort goes into expanding how many factories you

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And what he did was do a mathematical model where you start off with very low levels of

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: consumer good output, but then you would just go exponential.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now I took a look at that back when I was doing my master's degree, the training in

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: mathematics I took Feldman's equations and then looked at what was actually driving it

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: was, he was imagining correctly a huge pool of unemployed labor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: If you go back to the earliest stages of Soviet industrialization back in 1917, post the Second

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: World War, post the First World War, you had all these unemployed workers, you had all

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: these peasants you could take off the land and put into factories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you had a huge supply of workers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What you had to do was build the factories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you're building the factories, but at a certain point you exhaust the supply of

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: lowly employed or unemployed labor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And so rather than having this exponential takeoff, you hit a ceiling and then you can

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: only grow as fast as the population because you're not innovating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So that's what actually hit the Soviet system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And it's why they never buried the Western consumer goods.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And instead why Eastern consumers looked in envy at the goods being purchased by their

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Western people and said, if that's exploitation, we want exploitation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So okay, there's a lot of interesting stuff to ask here, which is, so Marx's vision for

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the socialist utopia is you have to go through capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Even the Mensheviks were true to Marx's original idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So is there a case to be made that in the long arc of human history on human civilization

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: on earth, that we're going to live out Marx's vision for utopia, which is like, will we

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: run into a wall with capitalism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I think we are running into a wall with capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: In fact, I think we've already gone through the wall and we haven't yet realized we've

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: smashed our skulls.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But on the other side, we're bleeding and everything like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Does Marx have any insights on what the other side of capitalism, what is beyond capitalism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I think that beautiful phrase of from each according to his ability to each according

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: to his needs describes what we should end up with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I think that's actually, if I think about, you know, I'm an Elon Musk fan, that's what

body.input: Yeah.

body.input: Because then Ricardo said this, it's actually better than Marx.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He said, they are things you cannot reproduce in a factory.

body.input: And that is the true focus of the capitalist economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: maximizing your usage of resources subject to constraints.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And as Kornai said, that's really what happened under socialism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What happens under capitalism is that you have 15, 20 companies producing automobiles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: They are all trying to capture as much of the market as they can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: If you add up their marketing plans, you're going to get 120, 130% of the actual market.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So they're all going to have excess capacity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: When you build a factory, you're building it with a plan for it to exist for five, 10,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: 15 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You have to have excess capacity in the factory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So that means that capitalism has far greater productive capacity than it actually uses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And then the way that you manage to get demand into your factory is to innovate and produce

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: something nobody else does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Before you're producing in volume and when somebody produces like a bung tire, comes

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: out of Firestone, then good gear is ready to expand its production and take advantage

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So that's the actual nature of competition in capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that means that we get a cornucopia of goods, even if we're lowly workers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The process can be captured in an extremely simple causal chain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Capital determines output, output determines employment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The rate of employment determines the rate of change of wages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Output minus wages and interest payments determines profit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The profit rate determines the, there's a very nice circuit here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The profit rate determines the level of investment, which is the change in capital, which takes

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: us back to the beginning of this causal chain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And the difference between investment and profits determines the change in private debt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And there's some nice, the Kean Minsky model and the intermittent route to chaos on page

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: 86 of your book.

body.input: Growth rate, private debt ratio, employment versus wages, employment versus debt, income
