body.input: So this is across years, like different trade-offs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Is there something interesting to say about the plots and the insights from those plots

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: that are generated on the software?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's a particular parameter values to give that outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But what happened when I first simulated the model, I took a model by a guy called Richard

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Goodwin who's one of the great neglected economists, American Marxist, mathematical Marxist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What he did was build a model of cycles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He actually wrote a paper called, it's only about a five-page paper published in a book

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: and a very, very obscure conference paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What he was doing was trying to build a model of Marx.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So he wrote it in 1967 and it was putting in a mathematical form a model that Marx came

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: up with in 1867.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So it was a centenary birthday present to Marx.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What Marx had argued in chapter 25, I think, of Volume One of Capital, section three, he

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: built a verbal model of a cyclical system and it's quite out of character with the rest

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of the book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So when you read Volume One of Capital, people think Marx has got a commodity money view

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He doesn't at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He simply did, the idea was he had like an onion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You start off on the middle level and you ignore the outer layer, then you bring the

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: outer layer in and so on and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Anyway, in this model, in Volume One of Capital, he normally just, you see, in work has got

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: a subsistence wage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: In this little chapter, he said that if the economy is booming, then workers will demand

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: wage rises and the wage rises will cut into the profit so that capitalists will not get

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the level of profit they're expecting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Therefore they will invest less and the economy will slump and the slump will mean workers

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: become unemployed and have to accept wage cuts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It was a model of a cyclical economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: As it happens, Marx spent his later years trying to learn enough calculus to be able

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: to model it himself mathematically and he never managed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There's Marx's mathematical notes on calculus, which are quite fun to read and if you have

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: a mathematical background-

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Did he get far?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Did he get far?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He got too caught up in the whole philosophy and he never really got to build the model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But what Goodman realized was a predator prey model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay, the L'Occitane Volterra model was the basis of the idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what the idea is you have a prey and the example that L'Occitane actually used initially

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: was grass.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Grass is the prey.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And then you have a predator and the predator were cows.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you start off with a very few cows, lots of grass and then because of lots of grass,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the numbers of cows grow and then because the cows grow, they start to eat the grass

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: so the grass runs out so the cows starve and you get a cycle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And what L'Occitane was amazed by was that the cycles were persistent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: They didn't die out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So Goodman got that vision and he then built a predator prey model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I first of all read Goodman and really found it really hard to follow his writing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He's not a very good writer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But a guy called John Blatt, who was a professor of mathematics at New South Wales University,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: wrote a brilliant explanation of Goodman's model in a book called Dynamic Economic Systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I read that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It was superb.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he said a way you could extend this was to include finance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So I thought, okay, what I'm going to have is that what Goodman presumed is capitalists

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: invest all their profits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you get boom when there's a high rate of profit because they invest all that money

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: and then a slump when there's low profit because depreciation will wipe away capital and you'll

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: go boom and slump.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So I simply added in, well, capitalists will invest more than their profits during a boom

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: but less than their profits during a slump.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that therefore means they had to borrow money to finance the gap and pay interest

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: on the debt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So I ended up with a model with just three system states, the income share, the wages

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: distribution of income between workers, capitalists and bankers, the level of employment and the

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: level of private debt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And those three equations are fundamentally like going from the L'Octave Volterra model

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: with just two equations and therefore you get a fixed cycle to the Lorenz model where

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: you have three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And therefore what I got out of it was a chaotic outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what you're seeing is a manifestation of chaos, complexity in those plots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But one of the many fascinating parts about it was that as the level of private debt rose,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: in my model I had capitalists being the only ones who borrowed, but the people who paid

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: for the high level of private debt were the workers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The rising bankers share corresponded exactly to a falling workers share.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you can infer from that that the workers are the ones paying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Effectively, the workers end up paying for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: They get a lower level of wages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And the basic dynamic is that capitalists, when you have a three social class system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: your income goes between workers, capitalists and bankers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now in the system, the good one did, they're just workers and capitalists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So if workers share rose, profit capital share had to fall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But when you have three social classes, then capital share can remain constant while workers

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: falls and bankers rise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So that's what actually happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Because capitalists, the simple way I modeled it was there's a certain rate of profit at

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: which capitalists invest all their profits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Above that they borrow more, below that they pay off debt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what would happen is when you got back to that point, then the level of investment

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: would be a precise share of GDP and therefore you get a precise rate of economic growth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But if there was a higher percentage going to bankers and offset by a lower share going

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: to workers, it didn't affect the capitalists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what you get is the cycles sort of diminish for a while because there's the other, so

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the income distribution effect is important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the workers pay for the increasing level of debt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But the other side of it was that the cycles would diminish for a while.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now, what you get is a period of diminishing cycles, then leading to rising cycles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And technically this is known as the Pomer-Manneville route to chaos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And it's one particular element of Lorenz's equations of fluid dynamics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what they found was in examining laminar flow in a fluid, you have a period where the

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: laminar flow got more laminar and then suddenly it has started to get less laminar and go

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: turbulent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And this is what actually goes on in the model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So in my model of Minsky, so what you have is a period where there's big booms in cycles

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: and then as the debt level rises, the booms and slums get smaller.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that looks like what neoclassical economists call the great moderation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So when I first modeled this in 1982, I finished up my paper, which is published in 95, with

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: what I thought was a nice rhetorical flourish saying the chaotic dynamics of this paper

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: should warn us against regarding a period of relative stability in a capitalist economy

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: as anything more than a lull before the storm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now, I thought it was a great speed of rhetoric.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I didn't think it was going to fucking happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But it did because you had this period from 1990 through to 2007 where there were diminishing

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: cycles and the neoclassicals labeled that the great moderation and they took the credit

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: They thought that the economy was being managed by them to a lower rate of inflation, a lower

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: level of unemployment, less instability over time, and they literally took credit for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I was watching that and thinking that's like my model running and I'm scared as shit

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: that there'll be a breakdown.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I ended up not working in the area for a while because I wrote debunking economics and I

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: got involved in a fight over the modeling of competition in neoclassical theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That took me away for about four or five years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And then I got asked to do a court case in 2005, end of 2005.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I used Minsky as my framework for arguing that somebody who was involved in predatory

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: lending should be able to get out of the debt they were in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I explained Minsky's theory and I used this run-throw-away line as saying debt levels

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of private debt have been rising exponentially.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And then I thought, well, I can't, as an expert, just make a claim like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I've got to check the data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And the debt ratio was rising exponentially.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I thought, holy shit, we're in for a financial crisis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: are wrong categorically in 2014, when the bank lends, it adds to its asset side and

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: in your bank account.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what happens when you do your sums, credit is part of aggregate demand and aggregate

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: income.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's something I first solved in 2019, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: 2000 is the only recently proved it mathematically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what that means is credit is a component of aggregate demand and credit is also very

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: volatile.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So consumption demand never goes negative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Investment demand never goes negative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But credit can go from positive to negative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And when you take a look at the long run of American history after the Second World War,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: there was no period until 2007 where credit was negative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It was a positive component of your positive number.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Therefore, when you do it as a percentage of GDP, it was a positive percentage of GDP.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It peaked at 16% of GDP in 2006, 2007.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It fell to minus 5% in 2008, 2009.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you had a 20% of GDP turn around in aggregate demand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now when you plot that against unemployment, the correlation of credit to unemployment

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: across the period from about 1990 to 2010 is about minus 0.9.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Enormous negative correlation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now, according to the neoclassicals, it could be close to zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Imperially it's bleedingly obvious it's not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And it applies to every country in the world that had a financial crisis at that period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of their model.

body.input: And you're saying it's causation, not just cause.

body.input: It's causal.

body.input: Today we sit there is extremely high inflation.

body.input: What role does inflation play in this picture?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Is a little bit of inflation good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: We talked about money creation at the beginning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What's a little bit of inflation good or bad?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: A lot of inflation good or bad?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: How concerned are you about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: A little bit is good for a simple reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Again, it's taken me a while to get my head around this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But if you think about how people say, what are the functions of money?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: They say money, it's a unit of account, account, so you're measuring.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's a means of exchange and it's a store of value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now, yes, okay, it has those three roles, but the last one is contradictory to the previous

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And this is where you see this with the Bitcoin phenomenon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: If you want to hang on to money as a store of value, then if prices are falling, the

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: value of money is rising.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And it's actually in your interests as a store of value to hang onto it and not spend

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So that contradicts its role as a means of exchange.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now if you have money which depreciates, and this was actually tried in the Austrian town

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of Wargall during the Great Depression, if you have money that depreciates, then if you

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: don't use it, you lose it fundamentally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So it has a high rate of circulation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So there's a monetary theorist called Silvio Gizel and he wrote this proposal that money

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: should depreciate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he was ridiculed and opposed and derided, but Keynes said he was a great intellect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And the mayor of town of Wargall in Austria during the Great Depression was facing an

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: unemployment rate of 25% pretty much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Germany had the worst experience in the Great Depression in the world, as bad as America,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: slightly worse than America.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And so he thought, how can I stimulate demand here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So he produced a script which could only be used for buying goods and services in Wargall

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: and could be used to pay your local rates.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But it was depreciated by putting a stamp on the money if you didn't use it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So what happened was people would pay their rates, they needed to pay the rates using

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: this money, so the script, so they used the script.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And because it depreciated, you'd use it rapidly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So people were using that money, this alternative to the Austrian Schilling, and the economic

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: activity in town took off and unemployment fell to zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And it was an absolute miracle and everyone loved a Wargall experiment and the Austrian

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Central Bank sued them for establishing an alternative form of money and shut it down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Unemployment went back up to 25% again and Austria voted 99.6% for the Nazis, something

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: crazy number like that when Hitler marched in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the Wargall experiment showed that a depreciating currency led to a high rate of circulation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But of course, we're not talking Weimar Republic levels of inflation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So when you get that much inflation, and that's normally caused by, as the Weimar inflation

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: was caused by, the reparation terms imposed on Germany, fundamentally by France at the

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Treaty of Versailles, they paid a large part of that with just basically printing the notes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And you went into this crazy period of hyperinflation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So hyperinflation almost always occurs when there's a massive destruction of physical

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: resources and the monetary authority tries to paper literally over it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And then you get hyperinflation, that's total social breakdown.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So a moderate level of inflation inspires the means of exchange usage of money, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: undermines the store of value usage of money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that dilemma is why we have this antagonistic attitude towards inflation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I mean, you're describing as a tension, but it's nevertheless is like money is a store

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of value and a means of exchange.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: To push back, it's not necessarily that there's a tension.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's just that depending on the dynamics of this beautiful economic system of ours, it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: used as one more than the other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: If there's inflation, you're using it more for the means of exchange.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's deflation using more for store of value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But I don't see that as a tension.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's just how much you use it for those different...

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But it ends up saying that overall, the level of effective commerce, a bit of inflation

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: is a good thing because that's depreciating the money slightly and encourage its use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: there is money creation going on, it's private banks doing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And you get an increase in private debt and fundamentally private debt and its collapse,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: a collapse of credit when it stops growing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So...

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Well, I think this is like the Austrian thinking leaves out the debt deflation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's like, I think one of the most important papers ever written was by Irving Fischer

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: called the debt deflation theory of great depressions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Fischer was somebody who accepted the neoclassical vision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He wrote the pre-efficiency market hypothesis, efficiency market hypothesis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He had his own PhD called the theory of interest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And in that he argued effectively for supply and demand analysis of the financial system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he argued for equilibrium.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He said, when you're working with a commodity market, then the sale and the transaction

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: and the exchange occur at the same point in time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: When you're working with the financial market, then the exchange occurs through time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So he said he assumed that debts are repaid, all debts are repaid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he assumed that equilibrium through time was an essential part of his assumption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: This is...

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And then the great depression comes along.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he has become a major shareholder in rank Xerox because he invented the Rolodex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He's a tinkerer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And so he had taken out shares on margin and he was worth about 100 million in modern terms

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: when the great depression hit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And 90% of that was share market valuation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He'd taken out margin debt just like everybody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And with margin debt, you could put down $100,000 and buy a million dollars worth of shares.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you got this huge leverage into debt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now that when the financial crisis hit, the level of margin debt in America had risen

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: from half a percent of GDP in 1920 to 13% of GDP in 1929.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It then fell to zero again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's why the stock market crash in 29 was so devastating, that scale of margin lending.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And everyone was being wiped out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: They were selling Rolls Royces for 20 quid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You literally have photographs showing people doing that because a margin call comes in,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: you've got to liquidate everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you said the danger is of a debt deflation is what we have to avoid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that means you don't want too much private debt to accumulate and you don't want falling

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: prices because the falling prices will amplify the impact of being insolvent to begin with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's what we saw in the great depression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's partially what we saw in 2007, but we didn't have anything like the level of margin

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: debt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So there were limits on how bad it was in 2007.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But the danger is still the period of deflation amplifies your debts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I call it Fisher's paradox.

body.input: He didn't write those terms himself, but he wrote a line saying the more debtors pay,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And this is because you're liquidating to try to meet your own debts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: When you liquidate, the price level falls, you will end up having a lower level of monetary

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: debt, but a higher level of debt when you deflate it using the price level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So the biggest danger in capitalism is the debt deflation, far more dangerous than inflation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And the cause of debt deflation is?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Too much lending, too much bank lending, too much private money creation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And if you take a look at the 1920s, Calvin Coolidge explained the boom of the 1920s on

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: his surplus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He said, my government running a surplus of 1% of GDP, pretty much from 1922 through to

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: 1930, is the foundation of our stability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's a short embodiment of an idea as opposed to some super complicated, elaborate model

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of the economy and politics and all that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I mean, we could do that by using the insights that come out of modern monetary theory, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I've confirmed just using my simple Minsky models and that is that to use the term, you

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: usually have a feature, not a bug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: A government running a deficit is a feature of a well-functioning mixed credit economy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: not a bug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The government should normally run a deficit because that's how the government creates

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: We've also had this obsession from mainstream economists of running a surplus, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: what caused the Great Depression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Calvin Cool is doing it for eight years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Because of that obsession, we've cut back on social services, we've cut back on health,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: we've cut back on education, we've cut back on infrastructure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now, all that stuff predominantly affects the poor because the rich can afford to buy

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: it themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So if we had a son of which realized that the government should run a deficit, it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: a feature, not a bug of a fiat money system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's where Elon's made one mistake recently, by not going back to founded first principles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That deficit enables you to provide enough of a decent standard of living for those who

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: don't come out on top in the capitalist game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And with that, you wouldn't have the angst of the young people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now, we still have the climate parameters within which we have to survive, but a decent

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: level of government funding would mean the angst that you get where people say, I want

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: to be a Marxist, and they've got what I call a cardboard cutout version of Marx in their

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: minds, that wouldn't be happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So it's potential to have a good society where the government runs a deficit that finances

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the needs of the poor, where the rich get enough to indulge and take care of themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And you don't get this breakdown.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: If you try to cause the government running a surplus, then the burden of that is borne

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: by the poor, middle class and poor, and that will lead to the angst we're now seeing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That was a beautiful whirlwind exploration of all of economics and economics history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Let me ask you, you tweeted, I think, we are the opposite of ants, individually intelligent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: collectively stupid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: We need to develop systems thinking fast to counter our limitations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Do you really believe we're individually intelligent and collectively stupid?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Can you elaborate on, I mean, some of that is just cheeky tweets, but...

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's a cheeky tweet I've had in my mind for a long time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's one that actually went moderately viral, not enough, but moderately viral for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But nevertheless, what if you could analyze it as if it's some deep, profound statement

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: you made in a book?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Well, the reason is that we are the incredibly individually intelligent, things like these

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: devices we're playing with now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's the creation of individual minds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Creative individual mind and a collective labor over centuries that led to this level

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that has to be respected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's incredible stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But at the same time, I think what humans are, if you want to distinguish humans from

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: other species on the planet, we don't weave webs, we don't make bird calls.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah.

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Now...

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You don't think that's a catalyst for intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah, it is a catalyst.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But what it means is we can dilute ourselves as much as we can inform ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So because we share beliefs, we can do things in a collective way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And if we believe that if we take the incantations of the witch doctors and we happen to have

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: a couple of spears and things, we can go and attack the local her, the tribe of lions and

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: drive them out and we become the dominant species.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So it worked at the stage where we were in competition with other species on the planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So you agree with Einstein who said there are only two things that are infinite, the

body.input: That's right.

body.input: He wasn't sure about the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah.

body.input: So you think that the collective...

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I mean, there's an infinity to the destructive and the stupid, the inhumane that's possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: when we humans get together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But it feels like there's more trajectories, there's more possibility for creation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I think that's why we have to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I say, if we were built around the idea that our role as a species is to maintain and extend

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: life on the planet and if not find it elsewhere, then seed it elsewhere, then that is a vision

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: which makes us creative and confines the worst elements of our capacities to share beliefs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But if we go through and blame it, which is quite possible, we'll blame the technology

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: rather than blaming too much of the technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303
