body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's sort of accept the flow of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You really enjoy that book, The Earth of Arts, because it's got that same beautiful sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Life will survive whatever we do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I mean, they talk about the people...

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I was actually talking with a good mate of mine, an ex-geologist, and he's now a professor

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: of economics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he said as a geologist, he really hated people talking about the Anthropocene epoch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I said, well, it shouldn't be the Anthropocene epoch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It'll be the Anthropocene event.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Anthropocene epoch is millions of years and a huge period of life on the planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And we might be snuffed out in 10,000 years of human civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's not much slower than the meteors wiping out the dinosaurs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The dinosaurs lasted for a long time after that event.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So we'd just be a layer in the surface of the planet with plastics and strange metals

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: like that at some point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So we're just an epoch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Life will abide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Life will survive us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But there's so much life we're going to take down with us in this whole period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And there's so many of our own lives we're going to terminate for no good reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I'm looking at this Richard Tall character.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I'll definitely have to look at some of his papers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It does look like, boy, is he oversimplifying and do a lot of people...

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Oh my God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Check his one on how good it'll be to lose AMOC.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That said, I'm going to approach all of these topics with humility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I would like to have some conversations if people can recommend.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: My default position is always with the scientists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But even above that, my default position is with those who are humble versus those who

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: are arrogant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: This idea that because you're a quote unquote expert, you deserve to have arrogance is a

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: silly idea to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Again, going to the broader view of life on earth, nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Nature is the only one that gets to be arrogant and it chooses not to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So let me ask you about love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: What role does love play in this whole thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Did Karl Marx have a model for that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Karl Marx was madly in love with Genevieve von Westhalen and wrote love poetry to her

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: long before he wrote Das Kapital.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he was infatuated with her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He ended up also impregnating his housekeeper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So there's a son of Karl Marx who was the son of the housekeeper, not the Jenny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There are numerous daughters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So he had a complicated view of love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Oh yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There's a dialectic on love there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He had an idealistic view with Jenny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he was rejected because he wasn't, not by Jenny, she was madly in love with him as

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So it was a real passionate love affair from the very outset.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But then of course you have children, lots of them die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There's a huge amount of tragedy in his life as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He and Jenny were forced out of Chelsea by a cholera epidemic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: My vision for London back in the 1850s and 60s was Calcutta in the 1970s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's really what life was like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So there's a lot of hardship in his life as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And he was always poor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So only Ingalls kept him alive financially.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He applied for one job outside of...

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He never got an academic job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He was pushed out of Prussia as a newspaper author, but he also applied for a job as a

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: clerk in the British railway system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It was turned down because they couldn't read his handwriting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I think I'm a bit similar there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So yeah, there's a lot of love and passion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But in general, what do you think is the role of love in the human condition?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's vital.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I mean, that feeling of passionate desire and respect for somebody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And there's perverted forms of love as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So I'll leave that out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But somebody having a really deep bond which goes beyond just sexual attraction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I've had that four or five times in my life with different women at different times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I've stuffed up the most important one very early on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That feeling is incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And you couldn't have life worth living without that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So it's an essential part of who we are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But what we have to do is to transfer it not just to the rest of our species, but to all

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: the species.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that's, I think, what's vital.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And how do we maintain that over generations?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I think that idea that we can actually hang on to that general sense of respect and

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: not lose it again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Because the amount of life we've terminated on this planet, the warlike side of humanity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: that is too much of a defining feature of our species.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: That's the opposite of love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's hate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But it's pleasure and inflicting pain on others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: When you see people killing others in a warlike environment, they're enjoying themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's rarely, sometimes it's self-defense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But when you have spoken to people who have been involved in combat and been involved

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: in riots and said, when you see somebody rioting, bashing people up, they're enjoying themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's not anger they're feeling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's pleasure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: There's a dark aspect to human nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Very dark.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But there's also the capacity to rise above that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I think, like you put us on a spectrum between chimpanzees at one extreme and bonobos

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: at the other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: We're too close to the chimpanzees.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And bonobos are just having fun, having lots of sex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Every time they do anything, they fuck first and do the work later and then fuck afterwards

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: to celebrate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Fuck first, ask questions later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's like that Scent of a Woman, one of my favorite films, where Al Pacino gives advice

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: to a cat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: He says, when in doubt, fuck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: It's good life advice for a cat, especially.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You mentioned that death seems to be maybe fundamental to creating a conscious AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Do you think about your own death?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Do you, are you afraid of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I'm afraid of going through it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Not the other side?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You're not afraid of being on the other side?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I don't think there is another side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I mean, I'm agnostic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I'm atheist when pressed and agnostic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The one thing that I think I can understand why religion exists is that the whole thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: that something exists is itself a dilemma.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You have to take on faith that reality exists, whether it's a simulation or actual reality,

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: it exists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And that itself can't be explained in any scientific manner.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I mean, you can talk about antiprotons and protons and the sum being zero and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But why did it even happen in the first place?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So there's part you simply have to take on faith.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: So there was darkness before and there's darkness after.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: And I don't know if we're going to be alive on the other side of that darkness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: I think individually, no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: But the way you can live on is by what you do to human consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: How do you hope people remember you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: As someone who managed to integrate economics with an appreciation for life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Well, I have to say, as a bit of a callback, you're one deadly bastard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: You're a hilarious person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: The humility shines through, the brilliance shines through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Steve Keen: Marxism, Capitalism, and Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #303

body.input: Thank you so much for spending this time.

body.input: Okay.
